| Friend,

**Senate Democrats like Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders don’t give a darn about who comes into the United States through the southern border.** No, instead of sending even more money to protect border communities, fund our border patrol, and where it makes sense, erect barriers, the socialists in the Senate are too busy fanning the flames of inflation.

While our border patrol officers are being worked to the bone to protect the communities and the country they serve, Democrats in the Senate are too busy to look up and realize the biggest crisis at hand right now is one of their own doings.

Republicans on the other have a plan to stop the seemingly endless stream of migrant crossings. The only kicker right now is that Democrats are slightly favored to keep the Senate.

Would you fill out a few questions for us to let us know how we can get you more interested in this election? We need your votes to win. We need your attention and your support.

While these common sense promises seem obvious to most Americans, we are in an unprecedented time of domestic and global instability, worsened by an ever-increasing amount of U.S. federal government overreach. People want government leaders who will uphold our basic rights of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness. During our "#TEAMJAYME Diner Tour"), we heard that wholesale egg prices have increased from $1/dz to $6/dz and of food product supply shortages. How can a small business survive when the prices of the most basic goods have increased SIX TIMES! Business owners are doing all they can to stay in business while holding prices down... substituting menu items, opening for less hours and operating with a smaller staff. Dem Senators blame business owners for their “greed” when they have to raise prices. I would like them or Jim Himes to come out in OUR Connecticut community and speak to business owners and the countless others I speak to everyday who actually understand how the economy works. Our families are facing similar predicaments. You deserve a representative who will stand up to party leaders when needed. You need an INDEPENDENT** voice in Congress. We hear every day on the campaign trail how voters are tired of partisan, political rhetoric. We need to speak plainly and honestly on what is happening in our country. It is time to refocus and put the needs of our people before politics. Every day, they pump about $450,000 worth of misleading and false attack ads about Cheri into North Carolina.
#

Mitch McConnell’s super PAC is outspending us big time. Every day, they pump about $450,000 worth of misleading and false attack ads about Cheri into North Carolina.
Well, we cannot stop them from lying and trying to buy another Senate seat. But we can make sure their plan fails.
If just 1 out of every 7 people reading this made a donation today, we’d hit our goal well before the FEC deadline. We know not everyone can, but we need everyone who cares about expanding our majority and can afford to give to step up for Cheri now.
[**Will you please be one of the people Cheri needs to contribute today to close the spending gap, hit our FEC deadline goal and win this race?**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220928-4-MA&t=1&akid=1880%2E357359%2EokzcGG)

Their goal is to keep our economy and democracy rigged in their favor, and Ted Budd has proven he’s a reliable vote for their interests in Congress.
So there’s no limit to what our opponents will spend in order to win.
The good news is that the data shows we don’t have to match them dollar for dollar. Yesterday’s newest poll showed the race tied at 46%. Our job is to keep it close and make sure they don’t drown out Cheri’s message entirely.

| Hi ,
Trader Joe’s workers in Brooklyn, New York are unionizing. According to workers there, Trader Joe’s managers fired a Black union organizer hours after telling staff they’d learned about the unionizing efforts. This is part of what the workers call a “pattern of inappropriately targeting workers of color for discipline.” [**This outrageous targeting of a Black union organizer cannot go unnoticed. Please support our strike fund, so we can help workers fight back against their corporate abusers.**](https://gxdxdy.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE0Mjk4MyxcImxcIjo2NzU0MTg4NjQ0Njg2Mzg2MyxcInJcIjo2NzU0MTkxMTQ2Nzk4NDA5M30iLCJzIjoiODFlNzI0ZjlhNzFkYzdkOSJ9) All these Trader Joe’s workers want is a living wage, better healthcare and time-off policies, and clear, fair disciplinary processes. Work full time and be able to pay rent? That’s not so much to ask — especially from a corporation with over $16 billion in annual revenue. If you can, please support workers fighting for a living wage here: [**https://donate.stripe.com/00g3ec5jZbdH5Us4gl**](https://gxdxdy.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE0Mjk4MyxcImxcIjo2NzU0MTg4NjQ1MzE1NTMyMCxcInJcIjo2NzU0MTkxMTQ2Nzk4NDA5M30iLCJzIjoiNTFiNDlhMGQxMzNmNzQ2OCJ9)

Thank you,
-Rebecca Parson

Team — When I ended my U.S. Senate campaign, I made a promise to so many of our supporters: I told you I wasn’t going anywhere, and that I would always be in the fight to restore and protect reproductive freedom in Wisconsin. I'm keeping that promise by launching a new political action committee called **[Women Win Wisconsin](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51562393/369701780/377809102?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODI4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDQ5OTRmYS05OTNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bpt8gXaLa-AhnHUAWxooYsYT78B_mHjtSV_mpjcIJCY=&emci=20ac8d86-023e-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=844994fa-993f-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=18659593)**. Our mission is to mobilize women voters and elect pro-choice Democratic candidates in some of the toughest races throughout Wisconsin. Over the next few weeks, all of our efforts will go toward unseating Ron Johnson and supporting pro-choice women running in the most competitive state legislative elections of the cycle — races that will determine whether or not Governor Tony Evers has the power to veto dangerous bills passed by the Republican-led legislature. The way I see it, we can’t afford to sit on the sidelines and hope our rights and freedoms get restored. We’ve got to fight, and my hope is that I can count on you to join me. _Keep reading to learn more about our work to defeat Ron Johnson and save Governor Tony Evers' veto — and how you can get involved right now._
* * *
**Women Against Ron (WAR)** Between now and Election Day, WAR will work to unseat Ron Johnson by putting his anti-woman agenda directly in front of Wisconsin voters — especially women voters, who will be critical in the outcome of this tied race. Voters need to know the truth about Ron Johnson's extreme record on issues like abortion, childcare, equal pay, and so much more. We're going to make sure they get the facts before November through investments in digital advertising and targeted voter outreach in Wisconsin. **[You can support our continued efforts to defeat Ron Johnson and make sure we elect a new U.S. Senator who will fight for reproductive freedom by spreading the word or making a contribution today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51562394/369701781/1362669226?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODI4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDQ5OTRmYS05OTNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bpt8gXaLa-AhnHUAWxooYsYT78B_mHjtSV_mpjcIJCY=&emci=20ac8d86-023e-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=844994fa-993f-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=18659593)** | [VISIT OUR WEBSITE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51562395/369701782/1362669226?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODI4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDQ5OTRmYS05OTNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bpt8gXaLa-AhnHUAWxooYsYT78B_mHjtSV_mpjcIJCY=&emci=20ac8d86-023e-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=844994fa-993f-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=18659593)

* * *

**Women Save the Veto**
Wisconsin Republicans only need to win six seats to gain a legislative supermajority — giving them enough votes to override Governor Evers’ veto and push through draconian laws infringing on our private health care decisions.
Governor Evers has already vetoed _nine_ anti-abortion bills that passed the GOP-controlled legislature. He also called for a special session to create a path for voters to repeal the cruel 1849 abortion ban that was reinstated when Roe was overturned.
_We need to make sure Governor Evers is re-elected and save the veto._
That’s why Women Save the Veto is supporting pro-choice Democratic women running in six of the most competitive state legislative races in order to block a GOP supermajority, save the governor’s veto power, and ensure we have more pro-choice leaders fighting for our rights in the state legislature.
**Electing these six women will be critical to the future of abortion policy in Wisconsin.** We’ll work to arm endorsed candidates with the financial resources, strategic support, and infrastructure necessary to mobilize pro-choice voters in their districts and win. But we’re going to need a lot of help to get this done.
**[These races often come down to a few hundred votes, and we can’t leave it up to chance — not with Governor Evers’ veto at stake. Anything you’re willing to contribute to support these incredible women will make an important difference.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51562397/369701784/2002415448?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODI4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDQ5OTRmYS05OTNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bpt8gXaLa-AhnHUAWxooYsYT78B_mHjtSV_mpjcIJCY=&emci=20ac8d86-023e-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=844994fa-993f-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=18659593)**

clean_body: | Team — When I ended my U.S. Senate campaign, I made a promise to so many of our supporters: I told you I wasn’t going anywhere, and that I would always be in the fight to restore and protect reproductive freedom in Wisconsin. I'm keeping that promise by launching a new political action committee called . Our mission is to mobilize women voters and elect pro-choice Democratic candidates in some of the toughest races throughout Wisconsin. Over the next few weeks, all of our efforts will go toward unseating Ron Johnson and supporting pro-choice women running in the most competitive state legislative elections of the cycle — races that will determine whether or not Governor Tony Evers has the power to veto dangerous bills passed by the Republican-led legislature. The way I see it, we can’t afford to sit on the sidelines and hope our rights and freedoms get restored. We’ve got to fight, and my hope is that I can count on you to join me. Keep reading to learn more about our work to defeat Ron Johnson and save Governor Tony Evers' veto — and how you can get involved right now. Women Against Ron (WAR) Between now and Election Day, WAR will work to unseat Ron Johnson by putting his anti-woman agenda directly in front of Wisconsin voters — especially women voters, who will be critical in the outcome of this tied race. Voters need to know the truth about Ron Johnson's extreme record on issues like abortion, childcare, equal pay, and so much more. We're going to make sure they get the facts before November through investments in digital advertising and targeted voter outreach in Wisconsin. | = Women Save the Veto Wisconsin Republicans only need to win six seats to gain a legislative supermajority — giving them enough votes to override Governor Evers’ veto and push through draconian laws infringing on our private health care decisions. Governor Evers has already vetoed nine anti-abortion bills that passed the GOP-controlled legislature. He also called for a special session to create a path for voters to repeal the cruel 1849 abortion ban that was reinstated when Roe was overturned. We need to make sure Governor Evers is re-elected and save the veto. That’s why Women Save the Veto is supporting pro-choice Democratic women running in six of the most competitive state legislative races in order to block a GOP supermajority, save the governor’s veto power, and ensure we have more pro-choice leaders fighting for our rights in the state legislature. Electing these six women will be critical to the future of abortion policy in Wisconsin. We’ll work to arm endorsed candidates with the financial resources, strategic support, and infrastructure necessary to mobilize pro-choice voters in their districts and win. But we’re going to need a lot of help to get this done. = Women Win Wisconsin is going to build on the power of pro-choice women to restore reproductive freedom and win close elections across our battleground state — this November and beyond. But our work will be what supporters like you make of it, and by getting involved now, you'll help shape it from the very beginning. This isn’t my fight alone — we’re a team. So I’m asking you to join me in the tough work ahead of us, just like you did when I ran for U.S. Senate. We’re just getting started, so be sure to keep an eye out for other emails from me. subject: Peter, are you with me?
body:

---
| | Peter, The establishment and political class have failed America.
They've failed Arizona. They are only concerned about their OWN power, so they refuse to address the real problems we face. That's why the problems just get worse. We're seeing that now with the border crisis, rising inflation, failing schools, and growing distrust in every American institution. Those on the inside can't fix what's broken. They ARE what's broken. That's why we need an outsider NOW who can get things done.** ** **[I AGREE >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61437624:JWd3czVNq:m:1:3331421248:C32BA8024FBE43CE3CA5329AE9167F98:r)** _Just think about it ... Ronald Reagan didn't have political experience or government experience. President Donald Trump didn't either. We had great policies from these people._ I intend to bring policies to Arizona that are EQUALLY as great. I'm not coming into this game as a politician with a ruling class attitude. I'm taking on our real issues as a proud mom and as an American who is horrified by the action - and inaction - we're seeing in our government.
I think we're ready for another outsider to bring greatness to the people.**__** **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61437624:JWd3czVNq:m:1:3331421248:C32BA8024FBE43CE3CA5329AE9167F98:r) _**
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61437624:JWd3czVNq:m:1:3331421248:C32BA8024FBE43CE3CA5329AE9167F98:r)
---
[**I 'M WITH KARI: SECURE THE BORDER >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61437624:JWd3czVNq:m:1:3331421248:C32BA8024FBE43CE3CA5329AE9167F98:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. -> **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **_-> HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING! _**She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **_-> SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_-> SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST! _**Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61437624:JWd3czVNq:m:1:3331421248:C32BA8024FBE43CE3CA5329AE9167F98:r)
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61437624:JWd3czVNq:m:1:3331421248:C32BA8024FBE43CE3CA5329AE9167F98:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---

---
Sincerely,

body:
President Ronald Reagan | | | |

| | |
# THE FUTURE IS WITH REPUBLICANS AND PATRIOTS WHO STAND FOR THEIR OWN FAMILIES
\- 39 DAYS TO WIN

---

<<WATCH>>CLICK HERE
| [DONATE TO WIN](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=0878a9be23&e=5bb5efcda7 "DONATE TO WIN")
---
| The future doesn't belong to the fainthearted; it belongs to the brave. - President Ronald Reagan

Friends,
I just left the annual Crisfield Crab & Clam Bake - a tradition of our seafood and tourism industry. Yet, instead of Republican and normal family values being supported, a tent was erected by a former federal criminal lobbyist in Maryland to celebrate my opponent as if he was already coronated governor. But our team raised the flags of our nation and state and we had a great event reaching voters with our message of freedom just as we are doing all across Maryland, including in the deep Blue I-95 corridor.

[Abigail Martinez from California lost her daughter to a transgender indoctrination](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=8568dcbad1&e=5bb5efcda7) state that removed her from her care, causing despair and ending in the 12 year old's suicide in front of a train. Mrs. Martinez is warning parents to wake up. I am warning you: Wes Moore's similar policies are coming for your children and grandchildren.

FACT: My opponent pledges to force transgender indoctrination of your children behind your backs. Your objection will not be in your child's "best interest' in his State of Maryland. You could lose custody.

FACT: My opponent pledges to ban gasoline cars. His running mate co-sponsored the bill to do so by 2035 which will raise gas and electric costs now if they get power.

FACT: My opponent pledges to defund the police and "indict the systems". Kiss your safety goodbye and welcome Baltimore City crime to your neighborhood.

FACT: My opponent pledges to raise taxes and enforce the green new deal against our businesses. Why do business in Maryland if Moore taxes means you work three times as hard as a competitor state resident, only to make less?

FACT: My opponent pledges (and currently requires) jabs-for-jobs and a vaccine passport to enter society. Moore Lockdowns.

Never on my watch as your governor!

Petty politicians seek to defeat Maryland Republicans and all Freedom Loving Marylanders by opposing our candidacy for spite and vanity.

They ignore their own children and grandchildren's future at their own shame and peril.

The Far Left, and a few international lobbyist-connected lame-duck politicians, have joined together to destroy the family and our way of life. **_But our campaign is holding the line._** We need your help today to run through the finish line and win big.

We have 524,000 mail-in ballots to reach with the message of freedom today. We are short the postage of about $100,000 needed to mail these voters. We are raising the money but need your help now to reach our goal this week of $20,000 towards our immediate $100k goal.

Thank you for your commitment to our freedom and our families. Let's win.

For Freedom,

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor of Maryland

P.S. Instead of requiring my opponents' lying book for reading in Maryland schools, we should be requiring our Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas' amazing autobiography "My Grandfather's Son". It tells his story of how as Americans, we can become anything we set our hearts and labor to and that God's grace and blessing is what makes us great as a nation. I highly recommend this excellent book from our modern American hero Justice Thomas.

I know it's late, but I wanted to share exciting news with you before I head to bed.

**Something BIG happened today.**

**Governor Newsom signed SB 679 into law** , creating the Los Angeles County Affordable Housing Solutions Agency. This agency will finance 100% affordable housing, preserve current housing stock and protect renters. It will create cohesion and coherence within a region that is grappling with an acute housing crisis.

_This is a game-changer, to say the least._

As the largest county in the state and home to 10 million Angelenos (which is more than the population of 40 states), what we do and how we lead matters.

---
|
---
|
At the bill signing ceremony, Governor Newsom said that no city should be exempt from answering the call to build more affordable housing. After today, the County of Los Angeles and the 88 cities that comprise the region will have one more hefty tool in the toolkit to make that statement more realistic and accomplishable.

Fighting for this bill was harder than my probation reform bill and hurt worse than a root canal, but we got it done by working with labor, legislative leadership, housing advocates, all 88 cities, the County of Los Angeles, the business and faith-based communities and pro-housing legislators. It took two years of listening, earning buy-in and staying at the negotiating table. It also took humility – looking beyond my district in order to figure out policy that would benefit the 10 million Angelenos that make up this county.

Today was the culmination of all of this hard work.

**That is leadership.

That is vision.**

**That is why I am running for Congress.**

body:

---
| | Friend, What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people? Joe Biden's been in the basement for months. He pops out - delivers a massively unpopular plan for student loan forgiveness - and goes back to avoiding the public. That peek-a-boo act must be written into the official Democrat playbook because my opponent, Katie Hobbs, is doing the exact same thing! She refuses to debate. She refuses to show her face to the people of Arizona. If she's not making a plea to the radical left for more Soros money to fund her campaign, no one hears from her at all. This unaccountable, ridiculous behavior is so typical of a political establishment that does not value the voice of the people. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86075%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hPHRimh%2fKO5YJ%2fJ4PHJRPA&sysid=1)_ Now, it should be clear by now... **I'm not hiding.** That’s because**I’M NOT AFRAID.** I speak with the people every day because I believe that WE THE PEOPLE deserve to hear from both sides and get a fair idea of who will stand for you and who won't. _The silence is deafening. _ While conservative leaders like me on the NEW RIGHT are open books... The failing establishment elites are closed doors.
It’s time for us to say OUT WITH THE OLD, and in with the NEW (RIGHT) so we can SAVE AMERICA from these out-of-touch narcissists. **__[Are you with me?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86076%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pa5mPoHW0RjYgKdsNr2YGQ&sysid=1)_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86077%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KzCfg5GX8nPd6TGYQ4os2g&sysid=1)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I’m the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86078%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=d7AIMDdJ7vfg%2bi1gEcqWIA&sysid=1)
---
Together, we’re going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me... there’s a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I’ve always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that’s not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86079%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TXhgeMjQbLyVTB%2bY5l%2bNZQ&sysid=1)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There’s not a lot to do there, but that’s where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that’s what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that “BDE” that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me “Kari, you’re going to be the DeSantis of the West.” Other than being called “Trump in a Dress -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you’re going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86070%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1rLkewQNcPNGq4%2baWqIaag&sysid=1)
---
**Friend, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden’s ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Friend, let’s not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay. ** ** And it’s our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track. ** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. body:
Julie Anderson has placed voters before any political interests
to achieved impressive results. She is also the candidate with
the professional experience and expertise needed to hit the
ground running on day one.

Friends,

I don't know how close you've
been paying attention to the race for Secretary of State, but
this is an important one to watch.

As Republicans, we're always
pushing to have a smarter, better working government. To achieve
that, we need to elect those with experience. That's why I'm
endorsing Julie Anderson for Secretary of State.

As Pierce County's nonpartisan
Auditor for over 12 years, Julie has stayed out of partisan
infighting while improving customer service at the Auditors
Office. She has placed voters before any political interests to
achieved impressive results.

Under Julie's leadership, the
Pierce County Auditor's Office has received state and national
recognition. Her effectiveness in managing elections earned her
the support of over 40 bi-partisan and nonpartisan election
management professionals across the state.

Julie's proven nonpartisanship
isn't the only reason I urge your support for her candidacy. She
is also the candidate with the professional experience and
expertise needed to hit the ground running on day one.

Julie's opponent is a partisan
Democrat with no background in the duties of Secretary of State.
Appointed by Jay Inslee out of the state Senate, he is beholden
to his party. In fact, he has received over $100,000 from the
State Democrats.

The race for Secretary of State
is competitive, and Julie needs your help. Elway just released a
poll showing the race was essentially tied, with 40% of the
voters undecided. When running without a party label, it makes
fundraising that much harder. Will you join me in contributing to
her campaign?

This race is a choice between an
experienced elections professional and Jay Inslee's inexperienced
political appointee. Voters deserve to hear that message. I hope
you'll help ensure that they do.

A contribution of $100, $50, or
even $25 will help Julie reach critical undecided voters with her
message. I hope you'll join me in supporting Julie today!

Thank you,

Reagan Dunn
King County Councilmember

And to make matters worse...

[**I'm afraid I'm at the end of the road, friend.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8c330b630f30470db2b33455f14baa7f&_e=cqd4kMYxI3AbwWE4WHvJwhCWcWdrA_laigHiKIySrbR0am7vr0ORr9BjsxCjijM-ZMddfeaInIzuBWFCKHgMDTx9OlBpsCvraqb9cUn0uAL-hdDD1PfpczW2fvlyZY6WQVC9odaTfdCv0LTXyDuJqjWxSrE-7A1Wm8TLeen-CIMTrxLPY8_7yVmDhDwcPm8rS3CxoNtSlzMucuAnjYVaED8IVdi4fZGIzAmQkcubsjUPtgQQiO8o43fD-dA7qb_EJRQCRhsNdJxhyd2b6YTuZk-K-gint8RxvZKq-pRgBjOVhejtbAgzlRghuml0SZaNJWX3NllmXFEB9Po-cj_ukivWhdY24TKsv6Y103eYlBFyzyiqUKWPAZsqvryTSXirFDK_n2cdAptH0mX0K6hZ2pFG286iAXk25YtwZhbSc8ZySPmv4hpvLvpdbb_YEck2)

I hate to be so negative, but their war chest is becoming unbeatable.

**_And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are starting to suffer the same fate._**

This is Tiffany Smiley. I'm a first-time candidate, veterans advocate, and political outsider. I'm the mother of 3 incredible boys and the wife of an Army veteran.

I'm also running for Senate in what could be the biggest upset in our nation's history.

I'm aiming to take down a 30+ year incumbent and flip Washington red. I'm working to start the red wave that allows us to take back Congress and restore conservative values to America.

So I'll cut to the chase.

[**I need your support and fast. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will make a difference in my election.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8c330b630f30470db2b33455f14baa7f&_e=cqd4kMYxI3AbwWE4WHvJwhCWcWdrA_laigHiKIySrbR0am7vr0ORr9BjsxCjijM-ZMddfeaInIzuBWFCKHgMDTx9OlBpsCvraqb9cUn0uAL-hdDD1PfpczW2fvlyZY6WQVC9odaTfdCv0LTXyDuJqjWxSrE-7A1Wm8TLeen-CIMTrxLPY8_7yVmDhDwcPm8rS3CxoNtSlzMucuAnjYVaED8IVdi4fZGIzAmQkcubsjUPtgQQiO8o43fD-dA7qb_EJRQCRhsNdJxhyd2b6YTuZveE4xDkbneLtLtGRZI9s7quVn5izD75DRpv39-S53r-wFvjdO4_fnyfnvDx3tc_VtX3EePBTCj5k83c78_nBVIiolm9rqTGufX6hPJY6voBpN9cXKYkm0cIImw8Da6Au-3kUKYfSoc920G2vNWOlVe1RHiK3ue_smqvMPW_SPE3)

We're in the middle of an uphill battle, but I know that with your support we will form a war chest of our own and defeat Chuck Schumer and the Democrats.

I'm gearing up to have the upset of the century, [**so will you be a part of my history making campaign by chipping in what you can before my 3rd quarter deadline?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8c330b630f30470db2b33455f14baa7f&_e=cqd4kMYxI3AbwWE4WHvJwhCWcWdrA_laigHiKIySrbR0am7vr0ORr9BjsxCjijM-ZMddfeaInIzuBWFCKHgMDTx9OlBpsCvraqb9cUn0uAL-hdDD1PfpczW2fvlyZY6WQVC9odaTfdCv0LTXyDuJqjWxSrE-7A1Wm8TLeen-CIMTrxLPY8_7yVmDhDwcPm8rS3CxoNtSlzMucuAnjYVaED8IVdi4fZGIzAmQkcubsjUPtgQQiO8o43fD-dA7qb_EJRQCRhsNdJxhyd2b6YTuZtuXcifTdpfCQ78JNtF7H0Jy2vY1JouKo-XCgsLa7xzQr9uJ8u5beUfRZGOMnUxmE7Zt_5wfrcioaBHmrsEb05qMTF0jyhSRgzdQ6jpzBMwO1dXpO6nokW7lzmpHpP0Pu_ve8HBV4VZTIWZLOIT7_6vlISYn0qF_YiUKsIb10vgm)

My husband and I are raising our boys to be honest men of their word, so I can assure you I'll keep my promise to restore your conservative values in the Senate.

[**I just need your help to get there.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8c330b630f30470db2b33455f14baa7f&_e=cqd4kMYxI3AbwWE4WHvJwhCWcWdrA_laigHiKIySrbR0am7vr0ORr9BjsxCjijM-ZMddfeaInIzuBWFCKHgMDTx9OlBpsCvraqb9cUn0uAL-hdDD1PfpczW2fvlyZY6WQVC9odaTfdCv0LTXyDuJqjWxSrE-7A1Wm8TLeen-CIMTrxLPY8_7yVmDhDwcPm8rS3CxoNtSlzMucuAnjYVaED8IVdi4fZGIzAmQkcubsjUPtgQQiO8o43fD-dA7qb_EJRQCRhsNdJxhyd2b6YTuZjCun0NOAmxK4KsiecaXh2fYwtbo-Pa15EdLyfSXdr4RCQNWZQ-nepZF77L7tzADEJPVRhkau0wf2FQy9J_bJvbItEaB8LUWFL9VKaNJkJIWL2HuyvPDXHU3cFkRNuQf_EAeQwLmyLRKi1QZu8RNOmafy2G3XiZx2hXoVhnBciJT)

Thank you for your time and God Bless,

Tiffany Smiley
_Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate_

* * *
**Our country needs leadership, Friend.**
We need someone who will stand up and work to solve our nation's problems. body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” | | | This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63418cb36fd64937afe799f1304d1ac9&_e=5sRCREF_tewXZ9COyP2el6LmYgvee6TWvo9vsmaoMpXaSBZzcL7CSiEnq718g1qqZcNJLYUA2gWnosKTTGw2mduWcuRlubt_X_eQ3AMlsbxWtQHSLE8JtuCROpZ60IOk0BmXq4mJWcbfhlsvw7b4fzGylUqgc0GLZGDbWVQrRZtLVFTgiL0Llcv7McExJa7k2xrPCYEZKa7TGICM0QNy8VhK5dLBBAxadAwP0Jtv6BNFbnBW25RsbJeTkCHPiXK3ds15ewoavR896PnbGBB9qfQcRxt6-xI4WVMDU0iH-Oo06bxLHeW3iBa8RbmyrC063fAvnO-EE9QABi1JPIEMVoUPTa1xa8qtC7YqY6lLtxFiv_jeUW54kF88HKG0fKumCCDDKTCOa9mKBYPlg6F7UU3xC0fISbLmPFCeTEb44G0%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63418cb36fd64937afe799f1304d1ac9&_e=5sRCREF_tewXZ9COyP2el6LmYgvee6TWvo9vsmaoMpXaSBZzcL7CSiEnq718g1qqZcNJLYUA2gWnosKTTGw2mduWcuRlubt_X_eQ3AMlsbxWtQHSLE8JtuCROpZ60IOk0BmXq4mJWcbfhlsvw7b4fzGylUqgc0GLZGDbWVQrRZtLVFTgiL0Llcv7McExJa7k2xrPCYEZKa7TGICM0QNy8VhK5dLBBAxadAwP0Jtv6BNFbnBW25RsbJeTkCHPiXK3UomN2UFmw-SciY6sFcFqLctnvSt8h1mxAWWqpjTSBDKqyydpSao4SAjzVNO9iP4D6bAelCGVA_xqlZ9One7J9sJ1XDDhpfe_uUb86BCHKZcosSNAZr0NzJhf8Iew5EeuEtSjWd5koOqgtVFPckCq4WiLr28EyGomHiGBDtHtrj0%3D)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That 's why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63418cb36fd64937afe799f1304d1ac9&_e=5sRCREF_tewXZ9COyP2el6LmYgvee6TWvo9vsmaoMpXaSBZzcL7CSiEnq718g1qqZcNJLYUA2gWnosKTTGw2mduWcuRlubt_X_eQ3AMlsbxWtQHSLE8JtuCROpZ60IOk0BmXq4mJWcbfhlsvw7b4fzGylUqgc0GLZGDbWVQrRZtLVFTgiL0Llcv7McExJa7k2xrPCYEZKa7TGICM0QNy8VhK5dLBBAxadAwP0Jtv6BNFbnBW25RsbJeTkCHPiXK3zkSvqRVGQ7Qty7d-aflzyxxJ1AQl_D4MxhyP0HvpteQGy3FVbt3pg8u3k4FE67DlQ553CG8317ruW5J_Vwy3qp_ARmzRZCH6TkRuh9JFHBNrM8wYQfA2OnIq621AlK1DcbakbHGUfie7-H8EmkiUoi1TaTmqlMHzf_3jx2qGicg%3D)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

In a recent issue of Imprimis --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below? Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... . . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. Why is this? Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to reach and teach millions has never been more urgently needed. That 's why I need your thoughts quickly. By responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey on Socialism today. Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 Sent to Conservatives Give subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

_**A note from GOP Conference Chair Elise Stefanik:**_
---
I'll just say it, Friend, since no one else will.
_**We need 452 people from your area to step up by midnight or else we could lose the House. For good.**_

| |

| | | | [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86086%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RGbG7kKlO7rkp%2f%2fc8v9adQ&sysid=1 "It kills me to say this")
---
Friend, you know I hate to be negative.

There’s truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to _**[call it quits.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86087%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oP6snngBb7KWU3%2b7r%2fzkEw&sysid=1 "call it quits.")**_

My finance team just sat me down and delivered some devastating news... _**we’re about to come up $4,750 short of our End-of-Quarter goal.**_
---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86088%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3u9%2fK3rQn%2fcCRR8oU%2f9%2fvA&sysid=1 "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I’m genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don’t see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn’t be more severe and is why I’m asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I’m a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I’ve spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven’t spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that’s precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I’m bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I’ll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won’t put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We’re creeping into the final hours of this quarter’s deadline, but I know that we’ll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s deadline?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86089%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PBUwPpklMEPu%2fxHO%2b27WNA&sysid=1 "So what do you think? Will you be a part of
my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s
deadline?")**_

body:
I just got back from a weekend campaigning with Cheri Beasley in North Carolina, and let me tell you, the momentum here is real.
#

Folks - Doug Jones here. I just got back from a weekend campaigning with Cheri Beasley in North Carolina, and let me tell you, the momentum here is real.
There’s a real energy and enthusiasm on the ground for Cheri — especially in the communities that Democrats have had a tougher time winning.
That’s a testament to Cheri’s ability to talk to everyone, including rural and independent voters who can swing North Carolina. She just knows how to connect with people, listen to them, and when she says she’ll be a voice for them in the Senate, she means it.
She’s running a phenomenal campaign where no one is left behind or forgotten, but the kind of organizing and turnout operation that it takes to win isn’t cheap. We’ve gotta help her out.
[**Will you join me and support Cheri Beasley’s campaign today? Every donation, especially before tomorrow's FEC deadline, is absolutely critical.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220929-1-subs&t=1&akid=1883%2E357359%2EeMBEj6)
Some pundits have tried to count North Carolina out, and these are the same folks who said I could never win.
Sure, Democrats winning in the South is never a given, but we’ve proven that we can do it by investing in good candidates running grassroots campaigns. Heck, Cheri’s proven twice before that she can win statewide — even in tough midterms like 2014.
And just like in my race, she’s up against an extremist Republican who wants to end access to aborion, restrict voting rights, and overturn democracy — like Ted Budd tried to do on January 6.
The key here is that WE have to invest. Nobody can win a race like this alone.
[**So please, let’s help Cheri beat her Trump-backed opponent and expand our Senate majority. name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: We Demand Secure Elections
body:
Election integrity is an important aspect of a free society. Voting and choosing who will represent us in government is a duty that every citizen must exercise. The key wor
|
---
| | | | Election integrity is an important aspect of a free society. Voting and choosing who will represent us in government is a duty that every citizen must exercise. The key word in that sentence is “citizen”. A nation can not remain free, nor can we truly have a representative government if the representatives are selected by someone other than those being governed.We must have faith in our election system for our government to work properly.One important way to ensure our elections are held with integrity is by requiring proof that the person casting the ballot is indeed who they claim to be. Mississippi has been a leader in this area for more than a decade. In 2011, a citizen-initiated Constitutional Amendment was approved that requires eligible voters to present a photo ID before casting a ballot. This applies both at the polls on election day or in the Circuit Clerk's office if voting absentee.According to Secretary of State Michael Watson, more than 99.97% of all voters provided a photo ID when casting their ballot in the last election.[We Demand Secure Elections - Sign petition](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/198iAZC48spy2KxLC_jviA)The Secretary of State lists on his website the acceptable forms of ID:
* A driver’s license
* A photo ID issued by a branch, department or entity of the State of Mississippi
* A United States passport
* A government employee ID card
* A firearms license
* A student photo ID issued by an accredited Mississippi university, college or community/junior college
* A United States military ID
* A tribal photo ID
* Any other photo ID issued by any branch, department, agency or entity of the United States __ government or any state government
* A Mississippi Voter Identification Card

There are three exemptions that allow a voter to cast a ballot without a photo ID, including religious objections to being photographed and military personnel casting ballots from overseas. Voter ID is one of the best ways to cut down on election fraud, but there is still more to be done in Mississippi to secure the integrity of our elections. The next important steps that Mississippi must take is
* Cleaning our voter rolls
* Putting greater restrictions on mail-in ballots to cut down on the opportunity for fraud.

[SIGN PETITION](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/198iAZC48spy2KxLC_jviA) and demand your Representative and Senator ensure our elections are secure!

Hello –

If you or your friends and family have been impacted by Hurricane Ian, I hope you are okay and staying safe.

Hurricane Ian came ashore as a powerful Category 4 storm. The destruction is heartbreaking. The storm devastated much of the Fort Myers area. A full recovery will take years. While we don’t know the death toll yet, it’s unfortunately very likely that this storm took the lives of fellow Floridians.

We know it will take lots of support to help rebuild what was lost and make southwest Florida, and other communities affected by Ian, whole. Now is a time where our community can make a positive difference.

**If you would like to help those affected by the Hurricane Ian, I encourage you to donate to the official Florida Disaster Fund:**

| When I was fighting for our nation in Afghanistan before my legs were blown off, the kind of reports I was used to were ones that detailed battlefield tactics, strategy, equipment and readiness.

Now that I’m running for Congress, I’m required to file a different type of report...

It’s the quarterly fundraising review with the FEC, which shows how strong our America First campaign’s support is every 3 months.

I never thought the fight for America would come down to reports like this one, but I can’t emphasize enough how important it is that we meet our goals when this quarterly report comes around...

**These FEC numbers go _PUBLIC_ , and if our support is at all lower than anticipated, _Democrats and their powerful allies will smell blood in the water!_** **On top of that,_voting begins in Florida at the end of this week._** Reporting weak numbers with all of this going on would be devastating... _It’s the last chance to show our strength before the Democrat mega-donors gear up for their final ad buy!_

Friends, I’ll get straight to it: We have not raised nearly as much money for this End of Quarter deadline as we wanted. Unfortunately, that means cutting back wherever we can to conserve resources for November. [**My recent ad**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zqd5djn0scvg2d5pc7qs2af83c49rohi7kl6o2gg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c5jm4o75cph2bs) highlighting the **radical taxpayer-last agenda of Taxin’ Tony Vargas** is up and running. But at the rate things are going, it’s looking like that will be short-lived. _Given where we are in our fundraising efforts,_**_they’re telling me I may be forced to reduce my ads off the air across the country_** _! _ I didn't want to make this decision, but until we see an uptick in support for our approaching End of Quarter initiative, this appears to be the only solution**.[ That’s why I’m begging for your help, Friends](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zn3vivgvv48v9m78fdvrq5llii3ga2nvasr6od50_rp22sh2s8i66or1c5jm4o75cph2bs)**[.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z0a5849l5vkkn2d295t6kl1igt1p2ocd8aut4i5o_rp22sh2s8i66or1c5jm4o75cph2bs) **Meanwhile, my radical opponent Vargas continues to see money pour into his campaign from Pelosi and her radical cronies!** I don't get the same benefits of being backed by wealthy elites.**[_I rely on conservative patriots, like you Friends, to get me through this!_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8lvjp9d97r6inmkq1a0vuofbem54365rqkeap10_rp22sh2s8i66or1c5jm4o75cph2bs)** **The more I can raise towards my goal, the longer we can keep these ads running and the more we can EXPOSE Taxin’ Tony’s plan to make Nebraska the fifth HIGHEST income tax state in America![ By pitching in as little as $15, you can keep my ad running for another 48 hours!](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zfp6hn6p8m6hi7kutnt1eruck5598io8kaj7vob8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c5jm4o75cph2bs)**

| Peter,

In addition to that outside spending, which is already well underway, Donald Trump has endorsed Mark’s opponent who recently announced his support of an extreme new national abortion ban. And to make things worse, a new poll came out this month that shows Mark’s lead has shrunk to just 1%.
So, it's clear Trump and National Republicans are already ramping up their efforts to beat Mark.

And now more than ever, the real battle starts. The people who run this country want to see us fail. JD

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The next 40 days, by the numbers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929&amount=28]
Team,
There are only 40 days to go until Election Day November 8th (and *1* day left until our "end-of-quarter" deadline). So, let me break down the numbers with 40 days left.
First, let’s talk about the new 7th district. After Michigan’s district lines were redrawn at the end of last year I announced that I would be running in the brand new 7th. It’s an area that is quite a bit larger than my current district, and a lot of that area is pretty rural. In total, I’m running to represent 7 counties (a significant increase from the 2.5 I currently represent), and I’ve gained 1,310 square miles and 28,382 more people.
So how have we been campaigning in the new 7th? Well, in each of my races, I’ve had one of the largest field programs in the Midwest – and this year is no different. To date, we’ve made 174,885 phone calls, knocked on 20,506 doors, and distributed 2,500 yard signs. Mobilizing people in a brand new area – in my case, the three additional counties in the new district – is hard work, so we’ve been hosting “canvas kickoffs” every weekend to train up new volunteers and send them out into their communities.
But, unfortunately I’m not the only person the folks in the new 7th are hearing from. They are being completely bombarded with attack ads. The spending against me in the new district is really starting to reflect that this is one of the ten most competitive races in the entire country. To date, more than $4.5 million has been spent against me in negative advertising, most of it from super PACs. My opponent has definitely decided to let those outside groups do his talking for him, and at this point, we expect GOP super PACs to spend an additional $4.5 million over the next 6 weeks.
With 40 days to go, we’re not leaving anything on the table. So here’s the last set of numbers I’ll throw at you: there are just 7 days to go until our September 30th “end-of-quarter” deadline. It’s our last big deadline before Election Day, meaning that all of the groups across the country who want to see my opponent succeed in the new 7th will be basing their spending off of the numbers we report after the 30th.
Here are a few more: it costs $5 to make a yard sign; $22 per hour to pay an MSU student organizer for the next 6 weeks of part-time voter registration; and $150 for a canvassing shift at MSU.
That’s why I’m asking if you’ll chip in anything you’re able to before our "end-of-quarter" deadline tomorrow, September 30th. Let’s make the next 40 days count! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929&amount=28]
Elissa

name: Karen Greenhalgh
subject: Preparing for Remnants of Hurricane Ian
body:
| | |
---
Dear Friends, While Virginia will escape the worst of Hurricane Ian, the remnants of the storm are expected to bring heavy rains and gusty winds to the Commonwealth for days, with some areas seeing as much as 8 inches of rain, with even heavier amounts in some places. Governor Youngkin has declared a state of emergency to ensure that state government is ready to respond as needed. Winds from the storm aren’t forecast to reach the level of a tropical storm, but with so much rain, any strong winds can knock down trees and take power lines with them. I wanted to share some informatoin that could be useful in the event we do experience significant disruptions from the storm. For helpful preparation tips, visit the [Virginia Department of Health](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/144156d1a82e3c5e/5e342f66600f9d78c3d6b838967d376c/37923). Contact information for reporting outages is below. To report power outages: Contact [Dominion](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/144156d1a82e3c5e/85c82b889aca7d1ac3d6b838967d376c/37923): (866) 366-4357, and their outage map can be found[ ](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/144156d1a82e3c5e/0d286ab0e58199c2c3d6b838967d376c/37923)[HERE](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/144156d1a82e3c5e/91fbde945856b545c3d6b838967d376c/37923). As always, if I can be of assistance to you, please do not hesitate to contact me.

| | **I first came to Congress driven to do all I could to help our local communities and families thrive.** My Democratic colleagues and I are making real progress to do just that. Our _veterans_? I have supported them my entire career, most recently through the passage of the **PACT Act** , which provides veterans critical access to the health care they need due to the hazards they have faced in the line of duty. Our _workers_? I will always stand with you. The**infrastructure law** we just passed protects workers while rebuilding America in a way it has needed for far, far too long. And I cannot fail to mention the fierce attacks against _abortion_. I am the only candidate in this race who will always fight for **access to safe and legal abortions** , and I will do everything in my power to stand with our progressive community in this critical fight. ... not to even begin to scratch the surface of climate change, gun violence, and addressing everything else that, to be frank, _only_ a Democratic majority will take on. **[These are the stakes in this election, and why I am asking for your immediate support as we close in on the coming end-of-quarter fundraising deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51612545/369840503/1596212816?refcode=2022-09-29-eoq2&recurring=0&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=f25097ee-2740-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjUwOTdlZS0yNzQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MEjhjtHp9BZ-86bRCn5SWlprQDN31yje6x9S3uLRYik=)** Because it matters right now. body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/23940?t=1007&amount=25&akid=5827%2E3611125%2EE63NWm ]Josh Radnor

At its heart, How I Met Your Mother was about love and family. Not
necessarily the family you were born into, but the ones we choose.

It was about people who loved each other and took care of each other. It
was also about resilience and believing in something bigger than
ourselves. It’s no accident that both the character (Ted Mosby) and the
actor who played him (me) are from Ohio.

I love being from Ohio. It was a great place to grow up and I always love
coming back. I still consider it ‘home.’

The people of Ohio are great: hard-working, unassuming, kind, and
compassionate. Ohioans deserve a Senator who models those qualities and
will produce real results. Tim Ryan is the man for the job.

His opponent—let’s be honest—is an ambitious shape-shifter who will say
whatever he can to get elected.

He’s absent any sense of guiding or ethical principles other than a quest
for power. And he’s beholden to a party that has abandoned any pretense of
believing in democracy, that every voice and vote matters.

Ohio can do better.
Ohio deserves better.

So much is on the line in this election. Ohio might very well determine
which party has control of the Senate. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/23940?t=1008&amount=25&akid=5827%2E3611125%2EE63NWm ]I’m asking you to join me in
supporting Tim Ryan’s campaign by making a donation of whatever you can to
help him pull ahead and win this important race.

I still consider it ‘home.’ The people of Ohio are great: hard-working, unassuming, kind, and compassionate. Ohioans deserve a Senator who models those qualities and will produce real results. Tim Ryan is the man for the job. His opponent—let’s be honest—is an ambitious shape-shifter who will say whatever he can to get elected. He’s absent any sense of guiding or ethical principles other than a quest for power. And he’s beholden to a party that has abandoned any pretense of believing in democracy, that every voice and vote matters. Ohio can do better. Ohio deserves better. So much is on the line in this election. Ohio might very well determine which party has control of the Senate. name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=472c6d10e8954c71a37ff0c1568ce9df&_e=vRDeSHj5OuuQOFNuTZtk5ym_zfFYxgwu5u0mWNqdkOkllx-lH_ev-AhwTDv0z1Nd6Mg1hfMW9GLCAPx6Xk8E8IeNbxrN7HHJbobvlK8sJoiA_gTrJf0E_bEKezhaZmDk2b_iIMoLYXqXhli54lMNIHzkBwXpCtD7Tjk0aiuWeA7DkQyHbE733ebSdfwUpdOgPV7LOnXXp8dzxb4BAbvCN46qo3-jWHCGDd9vaGSI4ak%3D)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=472c6d10e8954c71a37ff0c1568ce9df&_e=vRDeSHj5OuuQOFNuTZtk5ym_zfFYxgwu5u0mWNqdkOkllx-lH_ev-AhwTDv0z1Nd6Mg1hfMW9GLCAPx6Xk8E8FRwa2YC0xd902rQrklkVbmzsBnhSFHGLdUY23ELIms0XHMNU8qz_ghu6LQww08reqWf_XypeYabPykmsQtiYNfpNQU4JfiS-wyy8JL66sFs0VVpFseZz49hP-U0y7tNROuS8UcSZUNosAZF3ym_gwE%3D)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=472c6d10e8954c71a37ff0c1568ce9df&_e=vRDeSHj5OuuQOFNuTZtk5ym_zfFYxgwu5u0mWNqdkOkllx-lH_ev-AhwTDv0z1Nd6Mg1hfMW9GLCAPx6Xk8E8PnH1F7A6mNzLs4CVglHkx2F4edu1aoUzn-PbjwmXCzukFg5aOqZaMFDFZZhBXrvPoIgYdQCaC_84jcZ05OqnledRsenfrNVpWMCy-bj8-xRaOvBJabwi-7OCA4YfpN7xxWLBR2Gg62sECiBSvu4cvs%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=472c6d10e8954c71a37ff0c1568ce9df&_e=vRDeSHj5OuuQOFNuTZtk5ym_zfFYxgwu5u0mWNqdkOkllx-lH_ev-AhwTDv0z1Nd6Mg1hfMW9GLCAPx6Xk8E8Jif1Ddh3piogmubSXRGm_8O_hH9pfczQBt8nXbQql6Soy86FYNobA3iIkqsmzri7rgp2vOQdbW0877WeJ5IWw8Jeju5RXiMZicjXGzXWiyQ-P-1txWxUyHSvs_Rba_R-JO1Qw4Kz-Q23ixpA5mA_RU%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=472c6d10e8954c71a37ff0c1568ce9df&_e=vRDeSHj5OuuQOFNuTZtk5ym_zfFYxgwu5u0mWNqdkOkllx-lH_ev-AhwTDv0z1Nd6Mg1hfMW9GLCAPx6Xk8E8F3pFkNkYpuxrziCKMO3fXdA2a6_biu6KhEOgPPK4SzdkQ7ngS56CVmKkOoAiSNVfsPFPqzPOIO-6WT7OEttu2ap4q-y31x4pGL8QqI-Ra_NmcBZvqxs3OvyYP8V9JnzjPXPL2u5hLi9AFiZqhf-wWc%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=472c6d10e8954c71a37ff0c1568ce9df&_e=vRDeSHj5OuuQOFNuTZtk5ym_zfFYxgwu5u0mWNqdkOkllx-lH_ev-AhwTDv0z1Nd6Mg1hfMW9GLCAPx6Xk8E8AhVVMO0s66nbmPktJMNsm6Gj8RZTeOkAFv8H9-hVDoD5RRmb7X2PpxvrmbGsha3_ZDMvrOkr3d1_kKtyH2SeuVuTniE-Y-JHEf3SrvaWm_yUyvrabaKAVJB_P2F7wwEfGaVspIcblnU5tjBF0NKMVE%3D)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. * **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

clean_body: Peter, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. clean_body: Can we count on you, Peter? | | | Hi Peter – Across the country, new polling data is showing Democrats and Republicans within the margin of error in key midterm races. In South Dakota, for example, Democrat Brian Bengs is 2% ahead of John Thune in the race for U.S. Senate. These races will shape the future of our country, and we can't afford to take a chance on the outcome. The margins of error represent the difference between progress and continuous threats to our democracy. We're just one day away from the FEC's final reporting deadline, and we're still $1,000 short of our fundraising goal. My team and I have been working around the clock to make sure that we can protect our Democratic majority in Congress and in statehouses around the country. We're hearing from our supporters on the ground that issues like education, reproductive freedom, voting rights, climate action, and protecting democracy are top priorities in this election. We have the opportunity to make sure that our representatives act on those issues, but only if we act now. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: Thank you for your support in protecting our rights and the Democratic majority. – Joe Shepherd, President of United Rural Democrats United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. If we're going to take back our country, we need a 50-state strategy to organize in every community across the country. Will you support our network of activists on the ground as we work to rebuild our party's infrastructure and flip these areas blue?

| | | Peter Willis,

Please join me for a Women's Fundraiser in support of Montana Democrats and my campaign for U.S. Congress**TODAY, Sept. 29, 2022, from 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m.** at the Creperie in Helena.

Peter,

As your congresswoman, my focus has always been on listening to and supporting the people of Washington's 8th District.

Since I was sworn into Congress, I've helped thousands of constituents across our district, held 97 town halls, and had 14 bills signed into law including legislation to lower prescription drug costs, improve forest roads and waterways, prevent Medicare cuts, and more.

**None of what we accomplished would be possible without your support.**

We beat the odds by flipping Washington's 8th District blue for the first time ever in 2018 and kept it blue in 2020 – even with Republican dark money groups spending millions of dollars to defeat me.

Please give me a chance to explain why tonight is so critically important for Beto’s campaign.
#
Hey,
In just a moment, I’m going to humbly ask you to make a $3 donation to elect Beto as the next governor of Texas. But before I do, I hope you’ll give me a minute to explain why donating today in particular is _so important_.

Due to the weather predicted this weekend, the following events are rescheduled or cancelled. For those of you signed up to volunteer, please mark your calendars for the rescheduled date. Personality Fest - Rescheduled for October 29.
Bahama Day Festival - Rescheduled for October 29.
Mebane Autumn Fest - Canceled

Phoenix Fest - Rescheduled to Sunday, October 2 from 1pm-6pm at the Phoenix Crossing Center Parking lot
Granville Door Knocking - Rescheduled for October 8
Culture Fest - Postponed until May so this doesn't affect us.

Thanks everyone!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__

| |

If you evacuated, please wait until it’s safe to return, if possible. We are helping those in need with food and debris clearing. Some traffic lights are being repaired, and more, thank you to our first responders. Check road closures at [fl511.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51622314/369864511/-253778970?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzY4MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTUwMTE0ZS0zNDQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BmQZMblQhwo9ru__K7f70LYTHqcpnn3Rs9Ojl9YeOl8=&emci=20b024c2-3140-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&emdi=c950114e-3440-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=1139417).
