Friend, with just a single day left until my most important fundraising deadline of the election - our final quarterly FEC deadline - here's what you need to know about our must-win race:
First, my GOP opponent - handpicked by Donald Trump - started raking in cash from Republican megadonors across the country to try and defeat me.
Then, both the RNC Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel AND the head of the Senate GOP campaign group, Sen. Rick Scott (R-FL), descended on Connecticut to raise even more money to help my opponent flip this seat.
Now, with my fundraising numbers going public after tomorrow's FEC deadline, I'm facing a $16,135 budget shortfall - and running out of time to close the gap.
I must be direct with you, Friend. If we don't make up a shortfall like this before tomorrow's FEC deadline, Republicans will take it as a sign of weakness and pile on their attacks here. With Democrats hanging on to Senate control by the slimmest possible margin, we can't afford to let that happen.
[**So please, before this FEC deadline, will you rush a grassroots donation of $5 or whatever you can spare? I need your support to protect this seat and Democratic control of the Senate.**](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1262-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&amount=5)
Thank you,

disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
I’ve never needed you more than right now, so thank you for pitching in if you can.
#

I cannot overstate how grateful I am for the tens of thousands of people who have donated to our campaign just this month. I want to make sure you know just how important small-dollar donations are to our success.
When I think about our top supporters, it’s people just like you. How much you can give is not what is most important to me. What means the most is that you step up for our campaign when we need it most.
The support we’ve received from grassroots donors is why we are in a strong position to flip this seat. That support is why poll after poll has us tied. But September 30, 2022 is going to be one of the biggest tests of our campaign yet.
Tomorrow is one of those important moments where I am counting on as many folks as possible to pitch in. This final end-of-quarter FEC deadline is our chance to prove we have the resources and grassroots strength to organize in all 100 counties and flip this seat blue.
So I am asking:
[**Can you please make your first online contribution of $3 to my campaign for U.S. Senate? I am counting on your support to flip this seat and defend the Democratic Senate majority.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220929-2-MA&t=1&akid=1888%2E357359%2EeRTsXd)
**[DONATE](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220929-2-MA&refcode2=1888.357359.eRTsXd&t=2&akid=1888%2E357359%2EeRTsXd)**
Here’s the thing, it is only going to get tougher from here. I said when we started this race that we’d have to work harder than we ever have, and the stakes have only gotten higher since then.
With abortion rights, LGBTQ equality, democracy, and our planet all on the line, I refuse to slow down for even a second. We must win.
But staying on the path to victory requires us to reach our goal, and we’re not there yet. So it would make an enormous difference if you can give $3 or whatever makes sense for you at this link:
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-sep22?refcode=em220929-2**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220929-2-MA&t=3&akid=1888%2E357359%2EeRTsXd)
I’ve never needed you more than right now, so thank you for pitching in if you can.
\- Cheri Beasley

[1]Charles Booker

Hi, it’s Charles Booker, Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Kentucky
against Rand Paul.

Conventional wisdom holds that Kentucky is a ‘red state’ and that there’s
no point for Democrats like me even to try to win in the upcoming
midterms.

I reject this view. And I want to tell you why:

Kentucky is an ignored, exploited, disrespected, disenfranchised, and
unorganized state.

Kentuckians do not want big government abortion bans, cuts to their health

their basic needs.

Kentuckians oppose Rand Paul’s policies. And it’s time he was held
accountable for taking our Commonwealth for granted.

I want to tell you about why I’m supporting Nan Whaley.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51597887/369823601/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNzRmODQwNy0xZDQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=N7RM9acT-2cpNFagPKZeXnqy1AcQ8K1Vacyvf4uia3M=)

Hey folks,

Ohio is facing a turning point – which is why I want to tell you about why I’m supporting Nan Whaley.

Nan Whaley is running for Governor in my home state of Ohio. I met her when she was the Mayor of Dayton, helping her community through some really tough times.

I knew then what I know now: **Nan is the leader we need.** Her toughness and spirit helped Dayton persevere, and as Governor, she’ll focus on making your pay go up, your bills go down, and your government work for you.

**[Nan has what it takes to lead Ohio into our next chapter – and five new polls show that she’s in a close race with Republican Mike DeWine. But it's going to take an all-hands-on-deck effort to help her break the big-money machine currently in power. Will you join me in supporting Nan today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51597889/369823602/-1753171701?refcode=nw_em_220929_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNzRmODQwNy0xZDQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=N7RM9acT-2cpNFagPKZeXnqy1AcQ8K1Vacyvf4uia3M=)**

I hold my Ohio roots close, and I believe that Ohio deserves better than the current leadership. If we elect Nan as Governor, so much is possible: we can create a better future for Ohio, one where we bring opportunity back and put people ahead of politics.

But this will not be an easy fight: Outside Republican groups are already spending big in this race. We’re going to have to join together to help Nan win and create the change Ohio families need and deserve.

## The NFIB Federal PAC Endorses Supervisor Tom Patti for Congress
---
|
---
| Stockton, CA – This week, the National Federation of Independent Business Federal PAC announced their endorsement of San Joaquin County Supervisor Tom Patti for Congress in the Ninth District.

“As a small business owner, Tom Patti understands the operations and challenges of running a small business,” said John Kabateck, NFIB California State Director. “He has advocated for pro-small business policies in the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors and understands that small businesses are the community’s job creators. We are confident that he will be a strong voice for California’s small businesses in Congress.”

“I am proud to have the support of the NFIB for our campaign," Supervisor Patti said. "I will be a voice for local businesses and advocate for common sense policies that help rebuild our economy and create more good paying jobs in our community. As a congressman, I will make sure we protect the livelihoods of families and small business owners throughout our region."

Tom Patti has also been endorsed by the Lodi Chamber of Commerce, Supervisor Robert Rickman, Supervisor Miguel Villapudua, the San Joaquin Deputy Sheriffs Association, the Stockton Police Officers Association and the Stockton Professional Firefighters Local 456.
---
|
---
| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

| Dear Fellow American,

This is a very serious and urgent matter, so please hear me out.
Joe Biden and his radical allies are determined to open our voting booths to illegal aliens and other ineligible individuals ...which may help corrupt politicians steal elections _this November_!
Judicial Watch has the tools to challenge them...but [we need your special help!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60429&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

---

_Believe me ...voter fraud is real_!

For example, not long ago in **Texas** the Secretary of State announced that a departmental investigation uncovered _tens of thousands of ballots cast by illegal aliens in the past 4 years_ , although under federal law, foreign nationals (legal and illegal aliens) are not eligible to vote in American elections.

At Judicial Watch, we believe that voting is a highly valued right and serious responsibility of American citizenship. That commitment has put us on a long-term collision course with the radical open borders Left... _and that includes the radical Biden administration_.

You see, **Joe Biden** , liberals in Congress and the massive **George Soros** network are totally committed to "remaking" America through the electoral process.

Judicial Watch can help stop them...but [we need you to support us with a special contribution today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60429&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60429&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

**_One key component of their plan is to generate illegal votes from foreign nationals, so they believe that keeping our borders open to illegal immigration and allowing illegal aliens to vote will boost vote totals for candidates of the Left_**.

**_What other explanation can there be for the Biden administration 's abject failure to protect our borders and our national sovereignty_?**

Consider these numbers...

This year, the **U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP)** agency reported that March "border encounters" with illegal immigrants numbered **_221,303_** ...a whopping 33% increase over February's total!

Contrast that **221,303** with the **_50,000_** "encounters" reported in August 2020...when Donald Trump was still president!

Here are even more recent bad numbers.

At the end of August this year, the CPB revealed that **over 2.1 million "border** **encounters "** had occurred since the beginning of its Fiscal Year in October...an all-time high...and with another month to go, that's **400,000 more "border encounters"** than the _previous record of 1.7 million set in Fiscal Year 2021_!

There is _only one reason_ why the Biden administration gutted nearly all of the positive border security enforcement measures instituted by **President Donald Trump 's** administration:

_And it is the same reason_ why **Joe Biden** and his **Department of Justice** are attacking states that are passing commonsense laws like voter ID to ensure honest elections and make certain _that only eligible U.S. citizens are allowed to vote_!

**The reason is this: Joe Biden and his radical leftist allies want to create a massive new pool of voters ... _specifically including aliens who are in the United States illegally_****... whom they believe will overwhelmingly vote for candidates supported by the Left.**

**_Your vote and the lawful votes of fellow American citizens must not be cancelled by illegal votes and other corruptions of our voting rights_**

As an informed conservative, you know that we are non-partisan and do not endorse or oppose candidates for public office. But we will not stand by and permit election integrity safeguards to be violated for the gain of any political faction.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60429&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

Of course, it's easy to complain about the Left's efforts to make it easier for illegal aliens to vote in our elections...... _but**Judicial Watch** does far more than complain_!

Over the past several years, _thanks to your financial support_**, Judicial Watch** attorneys have scored a remarkable series of courtroom victories in upholding the rule of law and honest elections.

* In **Florida** , we threatened legal action that led to state election officials removing more than 50,000 deceased voters from their voter rolls.

* In **Missouri** and **West Virginia** warning letters from **Judicial Watch** were enough to succeed in spurring election officials in those states to begin cleaning their voter rolls.

* In **Pennsylvania** and **South Carolina,** we successfully defended voter ID laws in court.

* Our lawsuits in **California** , **Ohio** and **Indiana** led to more accurate voter rolls and other specific actions that protect against voter fraud.

* We are currently suing **Colorado, New York,** and **Pennsylvania** over their voter rolls, and in January we settled our lawsuit against **North Carolina** after the state removed more than 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

* And earlier this year we went to court in **Maryland** , and successfully challenged and overturned a "hyper-partisan" Democratic congressional redistricting gerrymander scheme that violated well-established congressional redistricting principles.

_You see, where others talk,_**_Judicial Watch_** _acts_! _And with real impact_!

This is indeed a critical battle...for the rule of law, and for the future of our nation.

**[So I urge you to help our team of talented investigators and attorneys challenge and stop left-wing efforts to corrupt our elections.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60429&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)**

The Left doesn't care about illegal immigration's potential to undermine our electoral process, or the disrespect it shows for the rule of law.

They only care about power, and for them the quickest way to get to power is to make it as easy as possible for illegal aliens and other ineligible individuals to vote in our elections.

_[So, I urge you to make your very best contribution to**Judicial Watch** today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60429&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)_. Thank you in advance for helping us stand tall for the rule of law!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton

| Hi, it’s Emma, Dan’s finance director. I’m reaching out before tomorrow’s major deadline to let you know that we still have $10K to raise to hit our FEC fundraising goal! **[Will you chip in $15 or any amount right now to help us close the gap?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51629096/369889476/1973352165?amount=15&contactdata=6kyXg1GASka7%2F1QfL0ijedpcRZ2xumdFRLqrTQuRjJaepDrSoWiZT5dz8SsV2qsv7AzlxHbdRPfXOSDxhjKmqS%2F0SMXdc4zv7M34xjTlb1PUPAuO2vuUERhZjQ2qPU5qgfUd%2BKIva32v3kU%2FGu6qwg%3D%3D&refcode2=c919ae8b-4640-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&refcode=EM_NBI_DK_20220929_FR_eoq.2.14_0_3MO_FD_NA_NA_eoq&utm_source=em_nbi_dk_20220929_fr_eoq.2.14_0_3mo_fd_na_na_eoq&source=EM_NBI_DK_20220929_FR_eoq.2.14_0_3MO_FD_NA_NA_eoq&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTE5YWU4Yi00NjQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g0rCDudHZbGztKDB82Yxvlgd4seJoypHakJ-JEAg1Sw=)**

The importance of this deadline cannot be overstated.

Every three months, federal candidates for office are required to report how much money they’ve raised. This is the _**final quarterly deadline**_ before the election, so the numbers we report are an indicator of grassroots strength in the final days of the campaign. All eyes will be on us since we are one of the most competitive House races in the country.

**This is also the time when our campaign is making our final budget decisions.** It’s in the next few days that we make our final campaign plans for the last stretch of the election. And, with more resources, we can grow our efforts to reach more voters about Dan’s work in Congress to lower costs for families and bring good-paying, union jobs to mid-Michigan.

My job is to make sure that our team has the resources they need to stay on TV, expand their direct mail universe, and support our staff and volunteers in the grassroots outreach efforts — _especially now that Michiganders are starting to fill out their absentee ballots._

I don’t take that lightly. So, missing this goal just isn’t an option if we want Dan to win. I’m keeping Dan and the team informed of our progress with just one day left until our deadline, and it would mean the world to Dan, me and our whole team if you would help us with a contribution today.

clean_body: Celebrating a victory, honoring our youth and new October Events you won't want to miss. | | MEKU, As most y’all know, we’ve been celebrating this week. Our coalition had been preparing for the worst, that the Manchin-Schumer Dirty Deal would stay tagged onto the must-pass annual government funding bill. Then we got the news that Schumer removed it, per Manchin’s request, just in time. Manchin’s hand was forced by our united grassroots mobilization, the September 8th rally and day of lobbying in DC and the many weeks of mass call-ins, letter writing and social media posts. ** ttps://7directionsofservice.com/blog/f/7-directions-responds-to-manchin-withdrawal-of-dirty-deal-text?linkid=1&canid=12471c8e444f80358077c9724aea85a0&source=email-no-sacrifice-zones-debrief-huge-success-2&emailreferrer=email1684101&emailsubject=we-can-rest-but-we-cannot-go-to-sleep are proud of this movement, especially our youth. We want to lift up our youngest Water Protector, Danger Winslow, as our inspiration. name: Patrick Leahy
subject: As my retirement nears
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Leahy for U
body:
Friend –

As my retirement nears, I am more committed than ever to leaving the Senate with a strong Democratic majority.

To maintain and expand our majority, we must ensure that my Democratic colleagues in "toss-up" states have the support they need to weather an onslaught of Republican attacks in the final weeks until Election Day.

Right on cue, Republican donors and groups are ramping up their spending in the last stretch, pumping millions into campaigns to defeat Senator Raphael Warnock in Georgia, Senator Mark Kelly in Arizona, Senator Maggie Hassan in New Hampshire, and Senator Catherine Cortez Masto in Nevada. Together, we can do something about it.

So, I'm coming to you: Before this last end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before Election Day, will you chip in $10 or more to be split between their campaigns?
https://links.e.leahyforvermont.

Recent polls in Georgia have Senator Warnock's Republican challenger up by three points. This race is almost certainly going to be a dead heat to the finish.

In my neighboring state of New Hampshire, Senator Hassan is up against Don Bolduc, a 2020 election denier. In 2016 she won by only 1,000 votes, and her re-election will almost certainly be just as close.

In Arizona, Donald Trump's approval rating is above President Biden's. And with Senator Kelly's Trump-endorsed opponent being bankrolled by billionaires like Peter Thiel, we can't take anything for granted.

Lastly, Nevada polls are showing Senator Cortez Masto currently down by one point against her GOP opponent. If she's going to pull back ahead and win, she's going to need our support.

To put it simply: Each of these races are going to come down to the wire, and we can't afford to lose any one of them if we're going to maintain and expand our Senate Majority.

Friday at midnight is the last official end-of-quarter filing deadline of this election cycle. Before each of these campaigns close their books for the last time, I hope that our Green Mountain PAC community can give them a strong boost of support.

Please, chip in $10 or more right now to be split between these four races, so we can keep the Senate in strong, blue hands.
https://links.e.leahyforvermont.

As we enter the final weeks of my final campaign season in the senate, it means a lot knowing I can count on your help with these important races.

Sincerely,

Patrick Leahy
U.S. Senator

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1004%2E61531%2EVyuyMu)
Hello,
We’ve got only 40 days left until Election Day, plus tomorrow is our final end-of-quarter deadline of the campaign. **[I hope you’ll consider chipping in to our campaign right away and help us protect the Senate, and here’s why:](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4415?t=3&akid=1004%2E61531%2EVyuyMu)**
I’ve been so fortunate to call Vermont my home for so many years now, and I’ve done my best in my years of public service to make our state a better place. I used to say I chose Vermont out of law school, but I’ve come to recognize that Vermont actually chose me, and I’ll take Bridge Street over Wall Street or K Street every time.
I remain committed to making our state and our country a more equitable place for everyone, and I’m going to continue fighting for progress on our priorities, like climate change, abortion rights, and lowering costs for working families. But Senate Republicans only seem interested in protecting the wealthy and powerful. Right now, they only need to flip one Senate seat to regain control and put Mitch McConnell back in charge. **We can’t let it be Vermont.**
Tomorrow’s deadline could have a major impact on the final month of our race. [**Please consider making a $5 donation or anything you can give to power us across the finish line.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4415?t=4&akid=1004%2E61531%2EVyuyMu)

I’m meeting with Lisa in a few minutes to fill her in on our progress, but right now, I don’t have good news to relay. As of 5:40 PM, our campaign is $2,107 short of our critical end-of-quarter goal, with only 24 hours to close the gap. If we want to put up strong numbers on our final fundraising filing before Election Day, then we need to act now, and we need to act fast. **[Will you chip in $10 or whatever you can to Lisa’s campaign before it’s too late?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51632186/369899870/1483338674?refcode=EM_FR_220929EOQ1_FR_NF_90DO_6_NG_TESTA_L1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Yjk2OTgxZS00ZTQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t2AJAuszhz-r3M3el0ncLjaPNlLtx8l8ip-gbmSp3To=)** [DONATE AN IMMEDIATE $10](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51632187/369899871/1483338674?refcode=EM_FR_220929EOQ1_FR_NF_90DO_6_NG_TESTA&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Yjk2OTgxZS00ZTQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t2AJAuszhz-r3M3el0ncLjaPNlLtx8l8ip-gbmSp3To=) These 2022 elections are not ones we can ignore. Our most sacred rights are on the ballot, and Republicans across the country are aiming to dismantle them one by one.

We’re in for a tough fight over these next few weeks, and if we don’t hit our $500,000 end-of-quarter goal by midnight tomorrow, we may not be able to put the resources we need into majority-making races in battleground states.

Peter,

It’s Lieutenant Governor Antonio Delgado — [_**reaching out to you to support my friend Josh Riley.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51619682/369853824/1712918886?refcode=BLU-JRFC-20220929-1-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODQwOWVlYy0yZjQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aMTyoQChdXeQDUxNfSneTHk8oWNr3bT6ujslBA4oygM=)

For over three years, it was my honor to serve the 19th Congressional District, and I know that my success in 2018 and 2020 was only possible thanks to the generous support of so many folks across New York.

It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. | [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=1ae9cbc91cd04de99cc0c5db5784b88d&_e=nMG8JckIq-zZ-lBk0EPk_hWoJAPXmfdktPo8OF93DJuRrmOfI-WEieJ5y8jZHG8PoRnYZLEXwwasvA5kDqj1-1sxd-QsP1LqW7V20fzB6qJtLJ_FU9RHpi8mWYlq9zoxgtUE0IIcrXJX9OYYZTXFQMgVhfuZPSHPdlQ7iIpkHs1uVa0ossH7kW8ZL8JGWmWgmHtpfae2TrQy2Qu7Xh5jMpL6pLMXw6gjQEPxCuohyhWTlw_7zMEwnGVU7hqcyq1MwdoTLGtpugiYHugeNwSBAuCpALL20SD2PdwcLq7DuA9GhFM-OoeAo2vPqHFCNms3)

Peter,

Do you know _why_ I decided to become a doctor?

It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country **desperately needed help**. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously.

As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field.

I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago.

I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need.

My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, **I felt called on to step up**.

For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. _**People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain.**_

I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously.

It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, _but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet_. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you.

In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. I am aware that what I’m asking may be difficult, but it is necessary – especially if we want to continue our hard work. It’s my calling to serve you, but [**I can’t do that with the Democrats in control of the House.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=1ae9cbc91cd04de99cc0c5db5784b88d&_e=nMG8JckIq-zZ-lBk0EPk_hWoJAPXmfdktPo8OF93DJuRrmOfI-WEieJ5y8jZHG8PoRnYZLEXwwasvA5kDqj1-1sxd-QsP1LqW7V20fzB6qJtLJ_FU9RHpi8mWYlq9zoxgtUE0IIcrXJX9OYYZTXFQMgVhfuZPSHPdlQ7iIpkHs2Y2GCk-NlM2qCUWeQhUmigpXRbSQB5jm-0zDReE16sjtH4fojED1KmCLDYD0OQ5p-qJuadPIhmTSYhkM-qv4gxmzgJE2DfZjRgz1R7YH7qFtFG0FjGGVK2pZESF_cUUl9zmODMyf20AoEPn_Bk2x7E)

subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=b454961ab57e4109abaa7d68bb848dc9&_e=6zIOfgfhPmK1dH8Jdl66EXLDi9S9n9YoQsgqN5zVVF3AsrRfXtRYr16i-RZyeOlNSUpoKAaP55PohtuZrGww10YPU53WnQsSrecTxtfhbxqNO4-48Osa-xNEMBnZ81g-nDfTsYv1ENjaNrvzEgHEFR_EVFt658yLw3jvYRnC1_Tw9mEbC1jsX6AMqKh61kWc9SCS2-s8LHSulKboJi8_b_hMrdtMzOwJNgyhgSbO0XZk2cbyTac41DHu_3wwTm4M)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=b454961ab57e4109abaa7d68bb848dc9&_e=6zIOfgfhPmK1dH8Jdl66EXLDi9S9n9YoQsgqN5zVVF3AsrRfXtRYr16i-RZyeOlNSUpoKAaP55PohtuZrGww19DrqZWazfs2llg19mUW8nRBNf2ZYeU6VHmhQDIi97JCTuMOrR1c7pwTDVtyWo3pcPqC2Fp5TheWXcZ31wuRkEeRvVIQrNpBQaQuQT9JR0fNRUy3SgW2DL6kIXhc517gJO4MqD3FqpDjQc9mzcDMbqOObJhajtaqlHI1-eqHbjCK)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=b454961ab57e4109abaa7d68bb848dc9&_e=6zIOfgfhPmK1dH8Jdl66EXLDi9S9n9YoQsgqN5zVVF3AsrRfXtRYr16i-RZyeOlNSUpoKAaP55PohtuZrGww10BQjWf4Xnviuxxy0-PdHCJf5TiovveF23RGtKoPu8c-Bj1k5YDHr6Gz6PFtTN4-B_cDvuco43j1ZsdAnyCqgOS4EvijIyo7oLLDxPrD5BUmzo_IpCb89OU2dJ4gnk3jQpFyD7MWx_p_NZ3uui-mmymwptXB3J5G4l8yY6dC5ipG)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

Hi Derek. Adam Schiff told me I could reach out.

11 years ago, I was shot.

The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language
function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I
speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.

Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.

With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. Through it
all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there
— pushing me, supporting me, making me laugh. And now, it’s my turn to
help him.

I know a thing or two about tough campaigns. And I can tell you one thing
for sure: This one is going to be close.

Super PACs and National Republicans are spending millions of dollars to
help Mark’s opponent take back Arizona’s seat. So, I’m asking:

There’s a lot on the line this election.
#
Derek, it’s Josh Shapiro and John Fetterman.

body:
The only way Mandela will run a successful campaign is if we're all in this together.
#
Friend,
Before I ask you to make a contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin, I would like to take a moment to say why it's so important that we help him defeat Ron Johnson and expand the Senate majority.
Let me be very clear:
Ron Johnson is a self-serving multi-millionaire who voted to give huge tax breaks to himself and his billionaire donors. How pathetic is that?
Mandela Barnes can defeat him – but only if we're all in this together.
The latest Marquette poll shows Mandela trailing Ron Johnson by one point, and Mandela is currently up against millions of dollars in ugly right-wing super PAC ads. Now more than ever, he needs your help to regain the momentum in this race.
So before Friday's FEC fundraising deadline, Mandela is relying on a lot of donations to show there is strong grassroots support for his campaign. That's why I am asking:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin before Friday's FEC fundraising deadline? This is important.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-sep22.TJJIPs&refcode=em220929-6-sbs2-acq-sp5&t=1&akid=3319%2E196590%2E4ACrcx)

Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. At a time of obscene levels of income and wealth inequality, we must address the needs of working families in this country.
As the son of a public school teacher and General Motors worker, Mandela knows the struggles of the working class. And if we can elect him to the Senate, he will take on the billionaire class and large corporations that control a large part of the economy and exert enormous influence over our political system.
But the only way Mandela will run a successful campaign is if lots of people come together and get involved in the Wisconsin Senate race.

In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

Fellow American,

When my colleagues see me coming, they joke and say, [**"there’s Barr, so it must be something about horses, bourbon, Toyota, coal, or the University of Kentucky!"**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=0c0c167bf0d84f67976eaf8aec5f5c44&_e=X8_sCmMCpZXgnN3MHUxDT5Se1nVuHX6PGN-NSMX3Pd8dD4_T3tcVG--8eYJ7WfGS9hYSFs3Sq3rxxQeYswpo_SqeQOqw9r8iTompXeiCCqHOdUuNGCBYautgkGVesDP7guIHGIlOCJDWx1aRkzhbXVfQ4CjzqAuBdTwy49iMwyeBLVNg-bzdBZpmdHPsn_1g0zGr76xrkyLRq3x2nhZmTlhX8rFxAbyuPcd408DTQSa8kC6wtDFnb5UQA5lhB_56CGAxtrneP3Evej4H18uN8fizt0U-PoqJT7c6nI0gfxk6i6BoBpkc2zroSs0Jdew5ob0f7aoF3wtCDd0KhfxleNXQa_xqxPRuW3bd2keYY2LOwVg3AzD2REfOqAuQX0C0)

_And they’re not wrong..._ I bleed Kentucky through and through. It’s where my family has always been, it’s the place that shaped me into the man I am, and it’s the Commonwealth that I’ve been so blessed to represent in Congress.

name: Laurie Teper
subject: Please Consider This!!
body:
Team Geels,
Monday, October 3 is a night that all Orange County residents should be concerned about. And all other North Carolinians should be watching carefully. Please read the message from Moms For Liberty Orange County Chair, Gretchen Schmid below regarding the BOCC meeting Monday night. WEAR YOUR COURTNEY GEELS SHIRTS! Unfortunately, Courtney has prior commitments and cannot be there. She did, however speak out on June 21!

Friends of Liberty!
Please consider joining us as we defend our first amendment rights in Orange County **Monday, October 3rd | 7:00 pm at the Board Of County Commissioners **where the commissioners will do a **new** first reading of ordinance 8-s, "Regulation of Gatherings on or near School Property and Public Playgrounds”. Because of public outrage and citizens who showed up voicing their concerns on June 21, the board delayed their vote on this ordinance until October for the first reading, revisiting this ludicrous idea coming from the Orange County School Board. For more information, please visit <https://occie.org/orange-county-tyranny#>

On the agenda for Monday night: <https://www.orangecountync.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_10032022-1651>
6\. Regular Agenda a. Regulation of Gatherings on and near School Property and Public Playgrounds

_Location:_
Whitted Building
300 W Tryon St. in Hillsborough

* **Would you like to help with public comment on the facts around the school board instigating this assault on the citizens of Orange County?**
**Gretchen is asking for 7 volunteers to read a 3 minute public comment that is already written out.**
If interested, please contact Gretchen at [gretchenms@pm.me](mailto:gretchenms@pm.me)
Planning and coordination session this Saturday 6:45pm - 7:45pm at 232 Orange Grove St., Hillsborough

*We will also be meeting prior to the meeting starting Oct 3rd at 6:30pm for final organization and planning before the meeting. Location TBD

Consider joining Moms for Liberty, Orange County!
**October Chapter Meeting**

**Thursday, October 6th at 6:30 pm**

We will be addressing organizational needs of the chapter, a fall focus for outreach to the community as well as outreach to the teachers of our county.

**Save the Date!!**
Friday, Oct. 21 New Horizon Church will be airing "Who's Children Are They?" at 7:00pm. Everyone is welcome to view. The church has a large auditorium. If you missed the opportunity last time to view this, I highly encourage you to attend.
Location:
100 Horizon Place
Durham, NC 27705

Continuing to spread the word about fighting for our freedom under the Constitution!! Pass it on!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651
[courtneygeelsforcongress.com](http://courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | | Peter, We're just six weeks out from Election Day — and the stakes of the 2022 elections are clearer than ever. **Authoritarian Republicans are waging an all-out assault on our communities. And if they win, we know they are planning to strip us of some of our most cherished freedoms.** The freedom to plan our own families and control our own bodies. The freedom to be who we are, and to be with those we love. The freedom to receive care or get an education without going bankrupt. Even the freedom of the people to decide who represents us in a democracy. Trump Republicans across the country haven’t been shy about these plans of theirs. **Our mandate from now until Election Day is to stop them at all costs — and to do it by electing more champions to office who will protect our freedoms and build an economy that respects working people.** I want to take a few minutes to spell out WFP’s plans for October and November in a little more detail, Peter. But before I do: **[We have one last quarterly deadline left to go before Election Day, and we are still short of our online fundraising goal for the quarter. Your donations — $3, $10, or any amount — help us reach as many voters as possible down this home stretch. Can you chip in before Friday at midnight?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUQ3tRep7Q_ZAvPjtQ9NGe1r1s7AlMSQg9xUJJRP45mGfQgSUaXRVmccdnhco0U3ea_5o77BgFyLmiiJVDg-gG8bi_ismv-ntr1miLIxujKhTf8uADaS8xBgouG1sk9NPUmocx-_ZQyW_XwECP5ZGr5iVZyUcdsXpXdaF2aGzJuggasi529vfTSg1PIKdQNfrLDUMP0E86ClCvplrDWJw_XIlxKciJ_9uNt0jQruPQYETTMTBB7F2_iut7ifGpjuY5J41-KF7uvFB-l4KbjuGaW9z4Re2ksqLi63AzuMXNzPDQswPR53OFe0lepk3pMlS7WzLHgXi8JElFawbHHNeTlQ8J1ioDAiV7pnGQqspnuFI/3pv/9ErZ9rHcRoqGpbuXTKM1Yg/h0/T8-PZXOgz42Rr3SKzNFz8J8GmPM2TDgq_n8YZCLAVlg)** **[Donate $3 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUQ3tRep7Q_ZAvPjtQ9NGe1r1s7AlMSQg9xUJJRP45mGeEUT-lMNib2wDOAcL8vNt9zaDTxS_z1dc45zcPQgIbL7hKiWw_gOxuqvubExewMUQfEDAsm8TFR58jEogyKpAPLPli_RXMFVR1f8io2i4bjAI0L9s8fsEdlmDAIHNw1aZAQE3dBovn7aAwen1v9dBNTIW-qY2TtkGAwgzdTmwJ_ffpPjbRwNiRgQZjdJgjwQck4771TlOzW6ckYyq-AKJYuhnepdKHrLp8K9kk4_sIcHMQBMlBBBmx9e_xuwOB1ZDnWXKsDwTMC4vaZ9FBv3kKltXHLdZFkO1VQazAoa6AxiaRmx6DAEOMnsYTbQsH9gQ/3pv/9ErZ9rHcRoqGpbuXTKM1Yg/h1/03y81AJH7hOOVQEZYs_cCuFGa7IuEkoHv03Nbn4PF1w)** At the Working Families Party, we came into this election with a three-pronged strategy to elect a Working Families majority that could protect our freedoms and fight for the future we deserve. Thanks to WFP members like you, we’ve already made incredible progress on all three fronts: **1\. Bolstering progressive power in the House.** Eight WFP champions won Democratic primaries for Congressional seats across the country this cycle. From union organizer Greg Casar in Texas to civil rights attorney Summer Lee in Pennsylvania to community leader Delia Ramirez in Illinois to Gen Z activist Maxwell Frost in Florida, they will join a progressive caucus that is bolder and stronger than ever. But for these new progressive leaders to make real change, we also need to keep a Democratic majority in the House. That means helping each one of our new candidates win in November, and defending vulnerable incumbents from Republican challenges. **2\. Fixing the Senate.** According to the polls, we are within striking distance of flipping Senate seats in Wisconsin and Pennsylvania. If we elect Mandela Barnes in Wisconsin and John Fetterman in Pennsylvania, we can bypass obstructionist Democrats like Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema and finally end the filibuster. That step alone will open the door for legislation to protect abortion rights, voting rights, union rights, marriage equality, rebalance the right-wing Supreme Court, and so much more. **3\. Winning in the states.** The battles for abortion rights, LGBTQ rights, economic justice, and racial justice are being fought state by state. Building power at the state level has always been a core mission of the Working Families Party, and we’re doubling down on that strategy this year. This primary cycle, more than forty WFP-endorsed new candidates for state legislature won their Democratic primaries. Now we’re going to make sure all of them win their general elections. Together, we can chip away at GOP legislative majorities in states like Arizona, Pennsylvania, and Michigan, while strengthening progressive majorities in Democratic states like California, New York, and Connecticut. **For nearly a quarter of a century, the Working Families Party has fought to replace corporate Democrats with peoples' champions, often through Democratic primaries. But that’s only part of our fight.** We can’t build the world we want to see — or defend our freedoms and communities — if we don’t stop right-wing Trump Republicans from taking over the government and the country. So we’re putting it all on the field this November to defeat Trump Republicans like Ron Johnson, Dr. Oz, and many more. From Pennsylvania to Wisconsin, from Georgia to Arizona and more, our WFP members are in the trenches knocking on doors, texting, phonebanking, and sending postcards. They’re talking with their friends, neighbors, and loved ones about what’s at stake this year, and making sure everyone they know has a plan to vote. That’s how we came together to beat Trump in 2020. That’s how we’ll beat the authoritarian right in 2022. I want to take a few minutes to spell out WFP’s plans for October and November in a little more detail, Peter. But before I do: At the Working Families Party, we came into this election with a three-pronged strategy to elect a Working Families majority that could protect our freedoms and fight for the future we deserve. Thanks to WFP members like you, we’ve already made incredible progress on all three fronts: 1\. Bolstering progressive power in the House. Eight WFP champions won Democratic primaries for Congressional seats across the country this cycle. From union organizer Greg Casar in Texas to civil rights attorney Summer Lee in Pennsylvania to community leader Delia Ramirez in Illinois to Gen Z activist Maxwell Frost in Florida, they will join a progressive caucus that is bolder and stronger than ever. But for these new progressive leaders to make real change, we also need to keep a Democratic majority in the House. That means helping each one of our new candidates win in November, and defending vulnerable incumbents from Republican challenges. 2\. Fixing the Senate. According to the polls, we are within striking distance of flipping Senate seats in Wisconsin and Pennsylvania. If we elect Mandela Barnes in Wisconsin and John Fetterman in Pennsylvania, we can bypass obstructionist Democrats like Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema and finally end the filibuster. That step alone will open the door for legislation to protect abortion rights, voting rights, union rights, marriage equality, rebalance the right-wing Supreme Court, and so much more. 3\. Winning in the states. The battles for abortion rights, LGBTQ rights, economic justice, and racial justice are being fought state by state. Building power at the state level has always been a core mission of the Working Families Party, and we’re doubling down on that strategy this year. This primary cycle, more than forty WFP-endorsed new candidates for state legislature won their Democratic primaries. Now we’re going to make sure all of them win their general elections. Together, we can chip away at GOP legislative majorities in states like Arizona, Pennsylvania, and Michigan, while strengthening progressive majorities in Democratic states like California, New York, and Connecticut. For nearly a quarter of a century, the Working Families Party has fought to replace corporate Democrats with peoples' champions, often through Democratic primaries. But that’s only part of our fight. We can’t build the world we want to see — or defend our freedoms and communities — if we don’t stop right-wing Trump Republicans from taking over the government and the country. So we’re putting it all on the field this November to defeat Trump Republicans like Ron Johnson, Dr. Oz, and many more. From Pennsylvania to Wisconsin, from Georgia to Arizona and more, our WFP members are in the trenches knocking on doors, texting, phonebanking, and sending postcards. They’re talking with their friends, neighbors, and loved ones about what’s at stake this year, and making sure everyone they know has a plan to vote. And we’re mobilizing voters in 30 states to get out the vote for our of Working Families Party candidates. That’s how we came together to beat Trump in 2020. That’s how we’ll beat the authoritarian right in 2022. But it’s going to take all of us, doing all we can, from now through November 8th. It’s crunch time. Let’s bring it home. Maurice Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you received this email as a forward and want to get the latest updates from the Working Families Party directly, The Working Families Party is the party of the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that cares for all of us. Wanna learn more? And if you need to update your contact information, Other political groups have corporate donors. But we can pool our resources too. | | **_Why I am supporting Christian Nascimento, and you should too._ **

**Our next member of Congress from Pennsylvania's 4th District must have a record of success out of government and the principled leadership necessary to get things done in Washington. On November 8, families and workers across the district have a unique opportunity to elect such a leader in Christian Nascimento. **

Christian is a commonsense conservative who will go to Washington and fight for you and your family. He believes that balanced and effective policies that put people to work and keep criminals off our streets should never be sacrificed for a radical, partisan agenda that only serves the fringes of society.

While in complete control of Washington, Democrats have failed America by catering to the partisan fringe. From gas prices and record inflation to reckless spending and shameful crime levels, it's clear we need real and significant change RIGHT NOW.

And it's clear that left's "Defund the Police" idea of change is not working for any of our communities. That's why Christian has the endorsement of law enforcement. He believes in standing up for police officers and victims of crime - not criminals. He believes in making sure that police have the resources and the freedom to take criminals off our streets and put them behind bars.

For these reasons and many more, Christian has my full-throated trust and support. On November 8, I hope very much that he has your vote.

\- _Congressman Glenn Thompson (PA-15)_

We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country.

Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign in Wisconsin. And if he wins in November, he will continue our struggle for justice in the U.S. Senate.

First, we need to come together to defeat a Republican extremist who denies the reality of climate change, participated in a scheme to overturn the 2020 election results, and has repeatedly sided with corporate interests at the expense of working people.

But this Wisconsin Senate race isn't just about replacing Ron Johnson. It's also about expanding the Senate majority so we can finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation to address the many crises we face.

Mandela Barnes is in a very close race right now, and he is relying on grassroots support in order to fund his campaign between now and Election Day. So I am asking you one more time:

And that's just to name a few.

But, in the midst of all these struggles, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country.

That means standing with candidates like Mandela Barnes who will take on powerful special interests. Thank you for adding a contribution to his campaign today.

In solidarity,

Steve Scalise

## **Mike Tyson Hosts Event for Former Trainer,**
**Republican Tom Patti for Congress**
---
|
---
| MIAMI BEACH, FL - It is not often that Black celebrities come out in support of a Republican, but Mike Tyson is proudly hosting an event at the Fontainebleau in Miami Beach this Friday, September 30 for his friend and former trainer, Tom Patti who is running for Congress in California. The event includes a private meet and greet at 6 PM and a moderated session with Q & A with Patti and the former champion at 8 PM.
---
| [One Night Only with Mike Tyson - BleauLive](https://tompattiforcongress.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35b3ff69952b238846e5a10cc&id=9b718418c6&e=5d7a2268d7 "One Night Only with Mike Tyson - BleauLive")
---
| **BACKGROUND: **When Tyson was being trained by his mentor, the legendary Cus D’Amato, Patti was the only other boxer living and training alongside him. Like Tyson, Patti appeared destined for a successful professional career. He was a Golden Gloves champion before his nose was broken one too many times and he was forced to retire.

But he and Tyson have remained friends to this day, united by their love and respect for the great D’Amato and the lessons he taught. He used to tell the two young boxers, “Not all my fighters may become champions, but if you apply these principles in life as you do in the ring, you will be successful no matter what you choose to do.” Patti had already seen that lesson firsthand as D’Amato had previously trained his father alongside legendary boxer Floyd Patterson.

The two recently reconnected in the boxing ring with Patti helping to train Tyson for his comeback fight against Roy Jones Jr. two years ago. And now, 35 years after their time in the Catskills together, they are fighting a new fight in the political arena.

**PATTI RUNS FOR CONGRESS: **The campaign launched last year with a fundraising dinner hosted by Tyson. Patti credits Tyson for getting him into politics. “I used to complain to Mike about the direction I saw our country going in and Mike said, ‘Tom, you are always talking about these things, why don’t you go do something about it?’” Patti said. So, he decided to run for the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors. Tyson gave Patti his first donation. Patti won and has not looked back. He won reelection two years ago, and is now seeking to flip a Congressional seat in the Stockton area from blue to red.

**TYSON A CONSERVATIVE?** Tyson himself has also been stirring the pot of late. He gave an interview to Greta Van Susteren in which he explained his recent switch to being a conservative. “As I get older, and I look at my children, and I see what’s out there in the world, I get a little conservative... it’s common sense, looking at the world we have now, you want safety,” he told her.

At the same time, Tyson acknowledged the risk he was taking in saying anything. “The last time I tried to talk politics [publicly], wow, did they give me a beating,” said Tyson. “I now stay away from politics and religion. They stole my freedom of speech.”
---
|
---
| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

Learn more by visiting [www.TomPattiForCongress.com](https://tompattiforcongress.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35b3ff69952b238846e5a10cc&id=505c72ecc5&e=5d7a2268d7)

As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=73e04efd89ff4468a8353e564529cbfa&_e=WvtsplKoJK4hCCgYDa_WFRzJNe9swAq5Dk359RMS68EE9PAqZWMmyYsf8IVJkA5NFJwZ9qzhMolmgY4WddPVdYYzW7OhY-Wsl9hl8I2kcFgG3fnV0H6Lz5zalTyD09PPxPawyh-NowXiKhT7NHZOFigUcZL8wnm9nxRnPge_51ahtkwU8tt7Gj9ajXsYMWV3WKMlc_kMRsXh72U0BpjFeYHS7kxwcqG_HvgQo1-Kg3XoyO14EgS2uRhU-KSMNxT35QmFPQR9qomhqR7538AX9xim8__LGsFfXFpUvP6IdGsaxMuZiUpSVPgEx6uY9MfT)

Fellow Conservative,

Do you know _why_ I decided to become a doctor?

It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country **desperately needed help**. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously.

As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field.

I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago.

I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need.

My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, **I felt called on to step up**.

For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. _**People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain.**_

I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously.

It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, _but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet_. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you.

In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. [**Will you please stand behind me in solidarity with your financial support?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=73e04efd89ff4468a8353e564529cbfa&_e=WvtsplKoJK4hCCgYDa_WFRzJNe9swAq5Dk359RMS68EE9PAqZWMmyYsf8IVJkA5NFJwZ9qzhMolmgY4WddPVdYYzW7OhY-Wsl9hl8I2kcFgG3fnV0H6Lz5zalTyD09PPxPawyh-NowXiKhT7NHZOFigUcZL8wnm9nxRnPge_51YV8MK73pLXh3y5d9I8p1sDAXesRyrkW--ZgffWMN06qZCW_URVRQLfmemVJqz9kwzjPXx--X6I1AjGN90Kv7jp9QvZz75iaSxRzAPFRo9VOgRJjNo36w4tv9rD6fvPTgEO_UsKvIda4QmdGCe3nJ4o)

[**STAND WITH GREG > **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=73e04efd89ff4468a8353e564529cbfa&_e=WvtsplKoJK4hCCgYDa_WFRzJNe9swAq5Dk359RMS68EE9PAqZWMmyYsf8IVJkA5NFJwZ9qzhMolmgY4WddPVdYYzW7OhY-Wsl9hl8I2kcFgG3fnV0H6Lz5zalTyD09PPxPawyh-NowXiKhT7NHZOFrg3bmVelBDUjA3d0sC757JE3hFEMerYbiU_j_xoIP30KGaIKT5dkoNysR-7c4kF1bZnQNjsX8UXiwgbiEtICyEUUYQG0nO8FRPQUyowcsUPDHnU3WJSnRdjH8oBDzJfcnY7LSiz5rRrFdwFhxUezKEtjzfNgpG2_6E6I0bC3lJTURaAZaLJ9zwL8pxQYg3Fiw%3D%3D)
I am aware that what I’m asking may be difficult, but it is necessary – especially if we want to continue our hard work. It’s my calling to serve you, but [**I can’t do that with the Democrats in control of the House.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=73e04efd89ff4468a8353e564529cbfa&_e=WvtsplKoJK4hCCgYDa_WFRzJNe9swAq5Dk359RMS68EE9PAqZWMmyYsf8IVJkA5NFJwZ9qzhMolmgY4WddPVdYYzW7OhY-Wsl9hl8I2kcFgG3fnV0H6Lz5zalTyD09PPxPawyh-NowXiKhT7NHZOFigUcZL8wnm9nxRnPge_51Z3h7NF1jRgEssr9m-Sk1XDJr8-2KXSjsjl9wlpju8RwZzHf-THR7jYQqKMgC3Z4SvDRxUqdLjQfwrl8EH1QiG4hQHouWyMuGmlfy7IonN2c0Hg53DZrx3lCM4QVBzMl7z_p5Ol7hhrvFv22NSkHTWA)

As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. I will continue to advocate for your needs and champion North Carolina values – just as I advocate for my patients and for the word of God.

[**STAND WITH GREG > **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=73e04efd89ff4468a8353e564529cbfa&_e=WvtsplKoJK4hCCgYDa_WFRzJNe9swAq5Dk359RMS68EE9PAqZWMmyYsf8IVJkA5NFJwZ9qzhMolmgY4WddPVdYYzW7OhY-Wsl9hl8I2kcFgG3fnV0H6Lz5zalTyD09PPxPawyh-NowXiKhT7NHZOFrg3bmVelBDUjA3d0sC757JE3hFEMerYbiU_j_xoIP30MWJOz3yGz5B9wp2toW2a4OftQRhWV8vQsQ5wuevnQqwawg30dPe4PIXMaA-4I7UN7fyRFfLrhrI09bpIAYYVKOfxNpv6DxRuyBsxVfcJtKhscL6tix9yiB6SsG_c25pOHjldWL5MNBIxwKot-eBytg%3D%3D)
Together, I know we can build a nation affluent in conservative values. [**Please consider donating today.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=73e04efd89ff4468a8353e564529cbfa&_e=WvtsplKoJK4hCCgYDa_WFRzJNe9swAq5Dk359RMS68EE9PAqZWMmyYsf8IVJkA5NFJwZ9qzhMolmgY4WddPVdYYzW7OhY-Wsl9hl8I2kcFgG3fnV0H6Lz5zalTyD09PPxPawyh-NowXiKhT7NHZOFigUcZL8wnm9nxRnPge_51Zy7JcTwLY0qhtHO_xMhx_K4SWJqAaJFrm6QKPEL10ppSR9x8MBZJvsFRCot8PYpieaAvymUmMDT-xX0quwNGyeWvbxe6wnM9DPpesHAZIkzNXh2hkXuceUQRp4Y5RxcTZoO7mx-lBsmHrzr5tTe4-U)

Thank you and God bless,
Greg Murphy, MD

body:
with less than 48 hours to go until our deadline, we have to ask one more time:
#

Hi friends,
A $5 donation.
That’s what we’re humbly asking of you ahead of tomorrow night’s FEC deadline.
$5 might not seem like enough to win an election, especially in a state like California, and especially compared to the millions of dollars Republicans will spend to try to flip this seat.
But when you chip in $5, and thousands of people across the country chip in $5, it starts to add up pretty quickly.
That is how we are funding this campaign. Regular folks like you from across the country chipping in what they can afford when they can because they believe in what we’re fighting for — like comprehensive immigration reform, universal health care, and protecting the right to choose.
**We’re all incredibly proud of that fact, and you should be too. But it also means that with less than 48 hours to go until our deadline, we have to ask one more time:**
[**Can Alex count on you to make a contribution — of $5 or whatever you can give — to our campaign today? We need a LOT of donations before tomorrow’s deadline to hit our goal and make sure we’re ready for anything that comes our way before November.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22.jTu8H1&refcode=em220929-1-30&t=1&akid=1029%2E159979%2Edl5sdV)

\- Team Padilla

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929_3&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929_3&amount=28]
Team,
We’ve come quite a long way since Elissa found out she would be running in Michigan’s new 7th district – and that it was going to be one of the most competitive House races in the country.
With our final “end-of-quarter” deadline before Election Day coming up on September 30th, Elissa sent an email earlier with a deep dive into the numbers behind this race. Take a look below.
In the meantime, we also wanted to ask if you would be willing to chip in before that September 30th deadline. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929_3&amount=28] In one of the ten most competitive House races, we’ve got our work cut out for us – and we’re doing all we can to make the next 40 days count.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929_3&amount=28]
Team Slotkin
Team,
There are only 40 days to go until Election Day on November 8th (and *1* day left until our "end-of-quarter" deadline). So, let me break down the numbers with 40 days left.
First, let’s talk about the new 7th district. After Michigan’s district lines were redrawn at the end of last year I announced that I would be running in the brand new 7th. It’s an area that is quite a bit larger than my current district, and a lot of that area is pretty rural. In total, I’m running to represent 7 counties (a significant increase from the 2.5 I currently represent), and I’ve gained 1,310 square miles and 28,382 more people.
So how have we been campaigning in the new 7th? Well, in each of my races, I’ve had one of the largest field programs in the country – and this year is no different. To date, we’ve made 174,885 phone calls, knocked on 20,506 doors, and distributed 2,500 yard signs. Mobilizing people in a brand new area – in my case, the three additional counties in the new district – is hard work, so we’ve been hosting “canvas kickoffs” every weekend to train up new volunteers and send them out into their communities.
But, unfortunately I’m not the only person the folks in the new 7th are hearing from. They are being completely bombarded with attack ads. The spending against me in the new district is really starting to reflect that this is one of the ten most competitive races in the entire country. To date, more than $4.5 million has been spent against me in negative advertising, most of it from super PACs. My opponent has definitely decided to let those outside groups do his talking for him, and at this point, we expect GOP super PACs to spend an additional $4.5 million over the next 6 weeks.
Here are a few more numbers: it costs $5 to make a yard sign; $22 per hour to pay an MSU student organizer for the next 6 weeks of part-time voter registration; and $150 for a canvassing shift at MSU.
With 40 days to go, we’re not leaving anything on the table. So here’s the last set of numbers I’ll throw at you: there *1* day left until our September 30th “end-of-quarter” deadline. It’s our last big deadline before Election Day, meaning that all of the groups across the country who want to see my opponent succeed in the new 7th will be basing their spending off of the numbers we report after the 30th.
That’s why I’m asking if you’ll chip in anything you’re able to before our "end-of-quarter" deadline tomorrow, September 30th. Let’s make the next 40 days count! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929_3&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220929_3&amount=28]

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

clean_body: Our numbers are showing we’re behind pace to hit our goal. | | I’m going to be honest with you, Peter. We are not in a position we want or need to be in as our Democrats have figured out a way to make this race for Utah’s Senate seat competitive by supporting a fake “independent” who will, in reality , vote with them. Unfortunately, many are falling for it and he’s raising more than we anticipated through a system that otherwise supports only Democrat candidates. The Left is funding my opponent’s campaign, Peter. We need to show that our fundraising numbers are stronger, and we need to have the resources to ensure Evan McMullin and the Democrats come nowhere close to turning Utah blue or even purple in November. More importantly, we need to be able to win back a Republican Senate and stop Joe Biden from continuing to wreak havoc on our nation’s prosperity, security, and freedom. Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
#
Hi Derek! 💕
My name is Alexis McGill Johnson, and I’m the president of Planned Parenthood Action Fund.
Did you hear what Dr. Oz said on a hot mic recently?
**Dr. Oz was caught on a hot mic referring to abortion at any stage of a pregnancy as “murder.”** And we’ve got the receipts.
People all across Pennsylvania know that Dr. Oz is a charlatan who’d be a rubber stamp for the GOP national abortion ban.
**That is why I am writing to you. We need to send reproductive rights champion John Fetterman to represent Pennsylvania in the U.S. Senate, and I’m hoping you’ll join me in supporting his campaign.**
**[Can you chip in $5 now to send reproductive rights champion John Fetterman to the United States Senate? John will protect our right to access reproductive health care, including abortion, and we need your help to get him elected.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ppfedpac-john-fetterman?amount=5&refcode=em20220929-7449&refcode2=7449_434096_knhOqC&akid=7449%2E434096%2EknhOqC)**
**[Contribute »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ppfedpac-john-fetterman?refcode=em20220929-7449&refcode2=7449_434096_knhOqC&akid=7449%2E434096%2EknhOqC)**
__
Let’s not be fooled, Derek. Nine out of 10 people in Pennsylvania support abortion rights. We won’t go back, and we won’t back down.
But there’s just no telling what kind of terrible policies Dr. Oz would support — from radical judicial nominees, to the extreme national abortion ban.
Dr. Oz cannot be trusted. The medical community, and communities across PA, are organizing against him. **Electing Dr. Oz would cost women their lives.**
That’s why Planned Parenthood Action Fund is thrilled to endorse the campaign of longtime reproductive rights champion, John Fetterman.
John Fetterman knows that abortion rights are non-negotiable. He has always stood up for you and your rights.
The stakes have never been higher. The choice could not be more clear.
We know we have a long fight ahead of us, **but we’ll have a fighting chance if we elect John Fetterman to the U.S. Senate.**
**[Abortion is on the ballot. Freedom is on the ballot. Will you join me in supporting John today with a donation of any amount to his U.S. Senate campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ppfedpac-john-fetterman?amount=5&refcode=em20220929-7449&refcode2=7449_434096_knhOqC&akid=7449%2E434096%2EknhOqC)**
**[Contribute »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ppfedpac-john-fetterman?refcode=em20220929-7449&refcode2=7449_434096_knhOqC&akid=7449%2E434096%2EknhOqC)**
So we won’t go back. And oh, hell no, we won’t back down.
In solidarity,
Alexis McGill Johnson
President, Planned Parenthood Action Fund
